Title: Manager, Application Support
Description:
**Who We Are**
As a leading Canadian wealth management organization, Richardson Wealth offers the personal touch of a boutique firm while delivering big results. With offices across the country, we are home to some of Canada’s best investment advisors. We’ve embarked on an exciting growth phase – a multi-year transformational journey to enhance our entrepreneurial, high-performing, advisor-centric culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Application Support Manager leads the team responsible for the health and support of Richardson Wealth’s business applications. The role oversees complex application support, incidents, escalations, operational readiness, service performance, and vendor support. The Manager actively participates in incident triage and prioritization, presents service health, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders, and demonstrates strong written and verbal communication skills. Tier 2 owns technical diagnosis and service restoration, while permanent changes are transitioned to the appropriate delivery, data, infrastructure, security, or vendor team. The Manager also develops team capability and uses knowledge, automation, and AI responsibly to improve service quality and efficiency.
  
  
*This is an existing vacancy*
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* People Leadership & Capability: Lead, coach, and develop Tier 2 analysts and specialists; set clear accountabilities, establish coverage and succession plans, manage performance, and build cross-platform expertise.
* Production Service Health & Supportability: Own the operational health, stability, and supportability of assigned applications, integrations, batch processes, data feeds, and operational services. Use monitoring, observability, alerting, logs, and service telemetry to identify risks, service degradation, and emerging issues proactively.
* Incident Management: Ensure complex incidents are triaged, prioritized, investigated, resolved, documented, and communicated in accordance with agreed service-management practices and business-impact considerations. Coordinate root cause analysis (RCA) for significant or recurring incidents, ensuring corrective actions are assigned, tracked, and completed.
* Escalation Management: Lead the response to complex and high-impact issues by engaging and escalating to the appropriate vendors and internal teams. Ensure clear ownership, timely updates, effective hand-offs, and follow-through until service is restored and required corrective actions are completed.
* Operational Readiness: Assess the supportability of releases and production changes, confirming that monitoring, runbooks, support procedures, access, rollback plans, vendor contacts, knowledge transfer, and hypercare arrangements are in place before transition to operations. Delivery owns release content and implementation readiness; Tier 2 confirms operational readiness and ongoing supportability.
* Service Performance & Reporting: Establish and report meaningful service measures such as ticket ageing, priority trends, service-level performance, repeat incidents, backlog health, root-cause actions, vendor performance, and knowledge effectiveness. Use insights to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* Knowledge Management & Shift Left: Build and maintain runbooks, known-error records, support procedures, and troubleshooting guidance. Partner with Business Support to move repeatable work to the lowest appropriate support level without transferring unresolved technical debt.
* Vendor & Third-Party Support: Manage operational support relationships with vendors, including case escalation, service reviews, defect follow-up, release impact, support obligations, and resolution of recurring service issues.
* Risk, Controls & Compliance: Ensure support activities follow change, security, privacy, access, audit, record-keeping, and regulatory control requirements appropriate to a wealth-management environment. Escalate material operational risks and control gaps.
* Operational Excellence, Automation & AI: Identify opportunities to improve support through automation, AI-assisted diagnostics, event correlation, ticket enrichment, knowledge retrieval, monitoring, recurring-task reduction, and reporting. Promote responsible use of AI with appropriate human oversight, data protection, validation, auditability, and control.
* Work Planning & Capacity: Balance reactive support, planned operational work, release support, problem remediation, and team development. Forecast capacity and raise trade-offs early when service resilience or delivery commitments are at risk.
* Business & Stakeholder Partnership: Build productive relationships with business, operations, compliance, delivery, and technology stakeholders; communicate clearly during incidents and provide transparent service-health, risk, and improvement updates.
* On-Call Support: Participate in and coordinate after-hours or weekend support when required for critical incidents, production releases, and time-sensitive operational activities.

**Qualifications**

* Post-secondary degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in support, production operations, service management, or a related technology field, including at least three years in a people-leadership or team-lead role.
* Experience leading complex incidents, technical escalations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and service improvements, supported by strong knowledge of ITIL-aligned service-management practices. ITIL certification is an asset.
* Strong technical knowledge of integrated enterprise application environments, including APIs, data feeds, batch processes, identity and access, databases, cloud or hosted services, and third-party platforms.
* Experience supporting operational readiness and production transitions, including monitoring, runbooks, rollback and hypercare planning, vendor coordination, and adherence to security, privacy, audit, resilience, and production-control requirements.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams on release planning, operational readiness, and continuous improvement.
* Strong people-management skills, including coaching, performance management, succession planning, and developing technical talent.
* Strong analytical and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify root causes, assess business impact, challenge incomplete information, and make risk-based recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to deliver concise incident updates and explain technical issues, risks, and trade-offs to business and executive stakeholders.
* Experience in wealth management, financial services, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accountability, sound judgement, customer focus, and attention to detail.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and French is an asset.

**Why Apply**
Our firm is only as good as the people who work here. Our employees are exceptional because they combine in-depth expertise with enthusiasm, and empathy. From our front office talent to our colleagues behind the scenes, we have one focus: to ensure our people thrive here more than anywhere else. Are you innovative, self-driven, and client-centric?
  
  
If so, we’re ready to invest in you.
  
  
**Richardson Wealth is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment. We are happy to meet your individual needs in keeping with the Canadian Charter of Rights and Freedoms and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Candidates may request accommodation at any point during the interview process.**

Title: Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology (T & I) (Telework/Hybrid)
Description:
**Position Title:**

Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology (T & I) (Telework/Hybrid)

**Status of Employment:**

Permanent

**Position Language Requirement:**

English, French

**Language Skills:**

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

**Work at CBC/Radio-Canada**

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance.
  
  
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

**Unposting Date:**

2026-11-27 11:59 PM

**Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.**

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technologies and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

**This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.**

**Role Vision and Impact**

The Senior Director, Information Security and End-User Technology, serves as CBC/Radio-Canada’s Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). A strategic, visionary and collaborative leader, the CISO defines, implements and drives the overarching vision for cybersecurity, risk management and technological resilience across all corporate environments.

The mission of this strategic role is to **protect information assets, data, digital heritage, and production and broadcasting infrastructure across all platforms, while ensuring seamless, agile and uninterrupted media operations.** The Senior Director optimally balances rigorous security architecture governance with the flexibility that creative, journalistic and technical teams need to innovate and broadcast without disruption.

Operating at a senior executive level, the CISO regularly briefs and advises the **Board of Directors (BoD),** the **Audit Committee,** the **CBC/Radio-Canada Senior Executive Team (SET)** and the **T&I Management Executive Team (MET).**

Supported by a team of experienced directors and senior managers overseeing governance, security operations, end-user technology and identity management, the Senior Director serves as the cornerstone of digital trust and strategic transformation for Canada’s public broadcaster.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Vision, Leadership and Executive Relations**

* Develop, champion and execute an enterprise-wide cybersecurity strategy aligned with the Corporation’s business mission, risk profile and digital transformation.
* Serve as a trusted expert and strategic adviser to the BoD, Audit Committee, SET and MET regarding risk status, security posture and maturity, and required investments.
* Foster a “Security by Design” culture and establish security architecture governance frameworks that keep operational and production workflows running smoothly while proactively managing risk.
* Anticipate technology trends and lead the secure integration of artificial intelligence (AI/GenAI) and automation into business processes and security defences across the organization.

  

**Securing IT, Cloud, Distribution and** **Broadcast/Operational** **Technology (OT) Environments**

* Define and continuously adapt the security strategy across the entire technology landscape, including corporate IT infrastructure, cloud systems, end-user environments, and critical production, broadcast and network infrastructure.
* Ensure the resilience of content acquisition, processing and distribution workflows against threats targeting the media sector and critical infrastructure.

  

**Governance, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance**

* Oversee the governance function responsible for developing, maintaining and enforcing policies, standards, security architecture principles, exception management and industry frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, AI frameworks).
* Lead the third-party and partner risk management program (covering vendors and technology contracts) in close collaboration with the Legal Services and Procurement teams.
* Co-develop a governance, compliance and ethical framework for the enterprise-wide use of AI and generative AI, assessing specific risks throughout their life cycle.
* Ensure strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., Quebec’s Law 25, GDPR and sector-specific requirements).
* Drive a cybersecurity culture and awareness program focused on lasting behaviour change across the organization.

  

**Defence Operations, SOC and Crisis Management**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline (12+3 or equivalent).

**What You'll Be Doing**
Nationwide CCTV Deployment Planning and Coordination
  
  

* Lead program level planning, mobilization, and delivery coordination for the nationwide CCTV deployment program within the agreed PMO scope.
* Develop and maintain the technical workstream delivery plan, including scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, risks, costs, and benefits, and provide validated updates to the integrated program baseline maintained by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls.
* Coordinate technical workstreams covering CCTV infrastructure, command-and-control platforms, connectivity, data storage, monitoring, analytics, cybersecurity, and systems integration.
* Define deployment models, implementation phases, site prioritization criteria, rollout sequencing, and readiness requirements.
* Coordinate and monitor the plans, interfaces, approvals, and readiness evidence of the client-appointed delivery entities responsible for site surveys, technical assessments, design, installation, integration, testing, commissioning, and handover.
* Ensure alignment between technology deployment, operational processes, service requirements, and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Monitor implementation progress and take corrective action where there are schedule, cost, quality, resource, or technical risks.
* Coordinate delivery activities across internal teams, contractors, technology suppliers, government entities, and other external partners.
* Coordinate confirmation of technical standards, acceptance criteria, quality controls, and documentation requirements with the responsible technical and delivery owners, and monitor the associated assurance and readiness evidence.
* Coordinate program level transition planning and readiness reviews for business-as-usual operations, including support models, maintenance arrangements, service levels, and operational handover.

Regulatory and Operational Framework Development
  
  

* Coordinate the development of regulatory compliance and operational frameworks required to support the CCTV program with the responsible client and specialist owners.
* Define policies, procedures, standards, controls, roles, responsibilities, and approval mechanisms for CCTV deployment and operation.
* Ensure that program activities comply with applicable laws, regulations, privacy requirements, data protection principles, cybersecurity standards, and government policies.
* Develop operating models covering surveillance operations, monitoring, incident management, access controls, data retention, evidence handling, system maintenance, and service support.
* Establish operational readiness criteria, service management processes, escalation routes, and performance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal, regulatory, cybersecurity, data protection, law enforcement, and operational stakeholders.
* Support the development of regulatory submissions, technical standards, operating procedures, compliance controls, and assurance documentation.
* Establish mechanisms for ongoing compliance monitoring, audit readiness, risk management, and continuous improvement.

Technical Laboratory Establishment and Operational Readiness
  
  

* Lead program-level planning and coordination for establishing the client’s technical laboratory as an innovation, testing, demonstration, and operational readiness environment.
* Define the Lab’s purpose, scope, capabilities, governance model, operating procedures, and success measures.
* Develop requirements for Lab infrastructure, systems, equipment, connectivity, cybersecurity, data environments, and testing capabilities.
* Coordinate and monitor the program plans, interfaces, and readiness evidence for the design, procurement, installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of Lab facilities and technology by the appointed delivery entities.
* Establish processes for proof-of-concept testing, solution validation, interoperability assessment, demonstrations, training, and technology evaluation.
* Develop the Lab operating model, including staffing, support, maintenance, access management, health and safety, and asset management.
* Coordinate operational readiness reviews, track readiness evidence and outstanding actions, and support formal acceptance of the Lab by the authorized client and operational owners before launch.
* Develop a roadmap for future Lab capabilities, innovation partnerships, vendor engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure that lessons learned and validated technical standards are incorporated into the wider CCTV deployment program

Procurement and Market Engagement
  
  

* activities, and market engagement.
* Coordinate the development and specialist review of technical requirements, statements of work, specifications, evaluation criteria, service levels, and acceptance criteria with the responsible technical owners.
* Support market sounding, supplier briefings, requests for information, requests for proposals, tenders, and competitive dialogue activities.
* Engage with technology vendors, system integrators, telecommunications providers, infrastructure partners, consultants, and specialist service providers.
* Assess market capability, technology maturity, supplier capacity, delivery risks, and commercial models.
* Participate in supplier evaluation, clarification sessions, negotiations, due diligence, and recommendation processes.
* Ensure procurement packages are aligned with the program roadmap, regulatory framework, operating model, and commercial objectives.
* Support contract mobilization, supplier governance, performance management, change control, and issue resolution.
* Monitor supplier delivery against contractual requirements, milestones, quality standards, and key performance indicators

Program Governance, Controls, and Reporting
  
  

* Apply the program governance, controls, reporting, and escalation framework established by the Program Manager – PMO Governance and Controls, and lead the corresponding technical assurance and operational readiness arrangements.
* Prepare technical delivery inputs to program board papers, steering committee materials, executive reports, dashboards, and delivery updates.
* Monitor program performance across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, issues, dependencies, benefits, and operational readiness.
* Maintain technical workstream registers, including risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, changes, actions, and lessons learned, and provide updates to the consolidated program records.
* Lead technical and operational readiness reviews and provide the technical evidence and recommendations required for program stage gates, assurance reviews, and health checks.
* Ensure that decisions and actions are documented, assigned, tracked, and escalated where necessary.
* Provide clear recommendations to senior leadership on program priorities, risks, options, and corrective actions.
* Ensure program documentation is complete, accurate, current, and compliant with governance requirements.
* Distinguishes ownership of the PMO governance framework and integrated baseline from Technical Delivery’s technical assurance, readiness reviews, and delivery inputs.

Stakeholder and Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Build strong relationships with government stakeholders, regulators, internal business units, suppliers, technology partners, and operational teams.
* Lead cross-functional workshops and facilitate alignment between technical, operational, commercial, regulatory, and procurement stakeholders.
* Manage competing priorities and resolve complex program-level issues.
* Communicate technical and program information clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
* Support stakeholder engagement, change management, communications, training, and adoption activities.
* Represent the program at internal and external forums, industry events, supplier meetings, and governance committees.

**What Required Skills You'll Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, information technology, project management, telecommunications, business, or a related discipline.
* 20 experience managing complex technical programs, preferably involving large-scale technology deployment, security systems, smart infrastructure, telecommunications, or public-sector transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading nationwide, multi-site, or multi-stakeholder implementation programs.
* Experience developing technical and operational frameworks, governance models, standards, and operating procedures.
* Experience defining and commercializing technology-enabled services or service bundles.
* Experience establishing technical laboratories, innovation centers, testing environments, or operational readiness facilities.
* Strong understanding of procurement, supplier engagement, tendering, technical evaluation, and contract mobilization.
* Experience working with CCTV, video management systems, command-and-control platforms, IoT, analytics, artificial intelligence, networking, cloud, cybersecurity, or related technologies.
* Proven experience managing program budgets, schedules, risks, dependencies, vendors, and delivery performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

**What Desired Skills You'll Bring**

* Program or project management certification, such as PMP, PgMP, MSP, PRINCE2, or equivalent.
* Degree or professional qualification in engineering, technology, cybersecurity, telecommunications, or systems integration.
* Experience in physical security, surveillance, smart cities, critical infrastructure, public safety, or government technology programs.
* Experience with privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and information governance.
* Experience with commercialization, product management, service design, or business development.
* Experience managing major systems integrators and technology vendors.
* Knowledge of enterprise architecture, systems engineering, service management, and operational technology environments.
* Experience with Agile, waterfall, hybrid, or scaled program delivery methodologies.

Description:

At Softchoice, a World Wide Technology (WWT) company, we work together to make a new world happen. As an IT solutions provider serving U.S. commercial and SMB organizations, as well as the entire Canadian market, we help organizations turn ambition into real‑world outcomes. We do this through the delivery of secure cloud, AI, software and digital workplace solutions that enable agility, innovation and growth.
  
  
With a highly engaged, high-performing team, we are certified as a Great Place to Work® in both Canada and the United States, and have been recognized as a Best Workplace in Canada for more than 20 years. We stand proudly for our people and their success through career development and advancement, and continuously strive to do what’s good for our people and communities.
  
  
As part of WWT, we connect customers to the global scale, advanced innovation, world-class partnerships, and deep expertise of a leader in AI and digital transformation. This includes access to WWT’s Advanced Technology Center (ATC), a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software that enables customers and partners to conceptualize, test, and validate innovative solutions before deploying them at scale.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
The Manager, Operational Excellence is responsible for leading the operational execution of Microsoft's licensing business and ensuring customer transactions are completed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with Microsoft program requirements and internal business standards.
  
  
This role provides people leadership and operational oversight across the full licensing transaction lifecycle, including quoting, contract creation and maintenance, ordering, amendments, renewals, and other related licensing activities. The Manager will work closely with Microsoft and internal stakeholders to translate program requirements into clear, practical, and sustainable operating processes. The role supports customers across commercial, public sector, and education segments and must understand how customer-specific requirements can affect licensing execution, documentation, compliance, and service delivery.
  
  
A key focus of the role is establishing and maintaining strong operational controls. This includes partnering with Microsoft and internal compliance teams, monitoring adherence to program and contractual requirements, maintaining audit readiness, and ensuring compliance requirements are consistently applied throughout each transaction.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong operational judgment, licensing knowledge, and a continuous-improvement mindset. They will strengthen the business through disciplined execution, clear accountability, effective controls, and thoughtful improvements to processes and tools.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* People Leadership and Team Development
* Lead, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing Microsoft Operations team.
* Establish clear objectives, expectations, and accountabilities aligned with department and business priorities.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, development planning, and objective monitoring.
* Build team capability through coaching, cross-training, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Ensure employees understand the Microsoft program requirements and internal controls applicable to their work.
* Manage staffing, workload allocation, scheduling, and coverage to support business volumes and service commitments.
* Foster a collaborative environment grounded in ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, and customer focus.
* Act as an escalation point for complex operational, customer, compliance, and people-related matters.
* Operational Leadership and Execution
* Lead the day-to-day execution of Microsoft licensing operations across quoting, contracting, ordering, amendments, renewals, and ongoing agreement maintenance.
* Ensure transactions are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with Microsoft requirements, customer commitments, and internal standards.
* Establish clear priorities, workflows, ownership, and escalation paths across the business.
* Monitor operational performance through scorecards, service levels, productivity measures, quality results, and other relevant indicators.
* Identify trends, capacity risks, process gaps, and recurring issues, and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken.
* Provide leadership and direction during complex licensing scenarios, high-volume periods, and customer-impacting escalations.
* Maintain effective business rhythms that give leadership and stakeholders appropriate visibility into performance, risk, and required decisions.
* Microsoft Program and Transaction Compliance
* Partner with Microsoft to understand changes to licensing programs, operational requirements, transaction rules, and partner obligations.
* Translate Microsoft requirements into clear internal procedures, controls, training, and operational practices.
* Ensure Microsoft compliance requirements are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, and other teams to establish and manage controls that support both partner and organizational obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and evidence to support internal reviews, Microsoft assessments, audits, and other compliance activities.
* Conduct or oversee periodic reviews of transactions, processes, and controls to identify gaps and confirm adherence to established requirements.
* Ensure compliance findings, transaction exceptions, and control failures are documented, escalated, remediated, and monitored through completion.
* Promote a culture in which compliance is embedded into daily operations rather than treated as a separate review after the transaction is complete.
* Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and relevant internal policies.
* Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary steps, improve quality, and reduce operational risk.
* Lead practical improvements to workflows, documentation, controls, reporting, and supporting tools.
* Use operational data, quality findings, audit results, and employee and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements.
* Partner with IT and operational improvement teams to define business requirements and support changes to systems and tools.
* Ensure process or system changes are tested, documented, communicated, and adopted effectively.
* Support automation where it improves accuracy, control, capacity, or customer experience without weakening operational oversight.
* Establish sustainable standard operating procedures and ensure they remain current as Microsoft requirements and internal business needs evolve.
* Measure the effectiveness of implemented improvements and adjust when expected outcomes are not achieved.
* Cross-Functional Partnership and Stakeholder Management
* Build effective working relationships with Microsoft and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, Enablement, and other business areas.
* Serve as a key operational contact for Microsoft on volume licensing execution, program changes, compliance matters, and escalations.
* Develop and maintain an understanding of the operational, contractual, documentation, and compliance considerations that may apply when supporting public sector and education business.
* Ensure new Microsoft requirements and internal business changes are evaluated for operational impact before implementation.
* Clarify roles, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths across teams involved in the licensing transaction lifecycle.
* Provide clear, fact-based updates to senior leaders regarding operational performance, business risks, compliance matters, and improvement priorities.
* Educate internal stakeholders on operational requirements and the information needed to support accurate and compliant execution.
* Balance customer and business needs with Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and operational controls, including the distinct requirements that may apply to public sector and education customers.
* Governance, Risk, and Business Management
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and customer risks within the processes managed by Microsoft Licensing Operations.
* Establish mitigation plans, monitor corrective actions, and escalate material risks appropriately.
* Maintain operational scorecards and reporting that provide visibility into service levels, quality, productivity, compliance, and improvement progress.
* Oversee process documentation, control ownership, decision records, and audit evidence within the team's scope.
* Contribute to operational planning, capacity planning, technology roadmaps, and business cases for process or system investment.
* Ensure changes to programs, processes, or systems have clear ownership, documentation, controls, training, and implementation plans.
* Provide functional guidance to internal teams on how Microsoft Licensing Operations integrates with their business processes and customer responsibilities.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* At least three years of progressive experience in licensing operations, customer operations, sales operations, or a related technology environment.
* Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, talent development, and workload planning.
* Strong experience managing complex, high-volume, transaction-based operations.
* Practical knowledge of software licensing, contract processing, quoting, ordering, renewals, and agreement maintenance.
* Experience interpreting external program or partner requirements and translating them into internal processes and controls.
* Experience supporting compliance reviews, audits, operational controls, or risk-management activities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive issues through resolution.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, Customer Success, and external partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate operational risks and requirements to senior stakeholders.
* A strong customer focus balanced with appropriate attention to compliance, accuracy, financial risk, and contractual obligations.
* Post-secondary education in business, operations, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Business improvement, project management, risk, compliance, or process-management certification is considered an asset.
* Microsoft licensing or comparable software-vendor program experience is strongly preferred. Experience supporting public sector or education customers, licensing transactions, contracts, or operational requirements is considered an asset.

**Compensation**
A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position in Canada is $95,000 to $110,000, annually + 12% as target incentives.
  
  
Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, education, and related certification. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ.

Title: Manager, Operations Integration Subways
Description:
**Job Description**
Metrolinx is connecting communities across the Greater Golden Horseshoe. Metrolinx operates GO Transit and UP Express, as well as the PRESTO fare payment system. We are also building new and improved rapid transit, including GO Expansion, Light Rail Transit routes, and major expansions to Toronto’s subway system, to get people where they need to go, better, faster and easier. Metrolinx is an agency of the Government of Ontario.
  
  
At Metrolinx, equity, diversity and inclusion are essential to living our values of serving with passion, thinking forward and playing as a team.
  
  
The Manager, Operations Integration – Subways plays a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable and efficient delivery of subway and LRT services. The position provides operational, technical and functional oversight of operator, maintainer and project agreements across the subway and LRT programs, supporting high-quality, customer-focused transportation services that are safe, timely and delivered in accordance with contractual requirements.
  
  
**What will I be doing?**

* Oversee the planning, coordination and delivery of subway and LRT services, ensuring safe, effective and efficient customer movement, service levels, schedules and operational plans align with Metrolinx strategies and organizational objectives.
* Manage operator, contractor and maintainer performance against service level plans, contractual obligations and KPIs; identify non-compliance, implement mitigation and corrective action strategies, and ensure quality assurance and continuous service improvement.
* Lead the development, implementation and monitoring of operational plans, management programs, policies, procedures, workflows, SOPs and performance measures in consultation with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable safety, regulatory, legal and contractual requirements through audits, monitoring, risk assessments and engagement with regulatory bodies, while incorporating industry best practices and emerging issues.
* Prepare and deliver executive-level reports, presentations and operational studies outlining service performance, KPIs, strategic directions, findings and improvement initiatives to Metrolinx leadership and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate operational activities across Metrolinx departments and business units, providing transportation expertise and input into major service improvement projects, service extensions, operational planning and negotiations with internal partners.
* Represent Metrolinx on contractual, operational and transportation development matters with service providers, contractors, consultants, industry associations, government representatives and other external partners.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partners, vendors and government representatives through ongoing communication, consultation, negotiation and issue resolution.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement by researching, recommending and implementing new or revised standards, specifications, processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, customer service, design standards and safety.
* Manage departmental activities, service delivery objectives and budgetary requirements while providing leadership, guidance and constructive feedback to contractors, consultants and partners, ensuring appropriate resources, capabilities, performance standards and positive working relationships.

**What Skills and Qualifications Do I Need?**

* Completion of a degree in Business, Engineering or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.
* Demonstrated years' of progressively responsible experience in the transportation and/or public transit sector, including leadership of frontline staff and/or project management, ideally within the public sector.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is considered an asset. A Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation is also an asset but not required.
* Demonstrated leadership and interpersonal competencies, including service-focused and transformational leadership, effective communication, sound decision-making, delivering results, building high-performance cultures, energizing teams, personal effectiveness and alignment with organizational values.
* Knowledge of applicable Human Resources legislation, including the Employment Standards Act and Occupational Health and Safety Act, as well as railway operating rules and legislation governing railway, environmental, public and employee safety.
* Strong knowledge of transportation, engineering and planning, including commuter rapid transit (subway, LRT and BRT) system planning, design and delivery, maintenance facilities, stations, storage yards and related infrastructure.
* Understanding of transit system functional requirements and technical components, including signalling and train control, SCADA, communications, trackwork, vehicle and wayside interfaces, traction power, power supply and distribution, mechanical systems, system and train simulation, tunnels, and fire and life safety systems.
* Knowledge of System Safety Certification processes and the ability to identify technical inadequacies, evaluate plans and apply appropriate rail transportation analytical tools.
* Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring and developing employees and contractors, applying collective agreement provisions, overseeing vendors and externally provided services, monitoring contractual performance, and understanding IT capabilities and budget planning and monitoring processes.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint), with strong written, verbal, interpersonal and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare reports and communicate operational studies, findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

***This role requires the successful candidate to be at the office, f**
**ive days per week, with regular travel throughout the Toronto area (at least twice weekly), availability outside regular business hours to maintain relationships and address operational issues, and site visits to transit operating environments, including train facilities and above- and below-grade track alignments. Personal protective equipment (PPE) is required at worksites.***

Title: Risk Operations and Visibility Manager
Description:

**Campus:** St. George (Downtown Toronto)

**Description:**

  

The Risk Operations and Visibility Manager position is part of the Information Security Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) team and will focus on the Risk Operations and Visibility function. This position will be responsible for monitoring and analyzing findings from vulnerability management and attack surface management tools to identify, prioritize, and track information security exposures across the University's environment and consolidating findings from multiple technical sources into a unified risk view of the University's threat landscape.

  

The incumbent shall possess advance knowledge of IT security tools and technologies amidst a continually evolving threat landscape and to apply such knowledge in evaluating the performance of the operational security risks by producing clear, actionable reporting and risk narratives for technical and non-technical stakeholders, including academic and administrative leadership. They will liaise with distributed IT teams across faculties and divisions to support timely remediation and closure of identified exposures and vulnerabilities while researching, recommending, and supporting the use of software and tools for vulnerability management, attack surface management, and risk reporting to build the internal expertise and function of risk operations and visibility management.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

  

EDUCATION:

  

* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information security, or equivalent combination of education and experience. A relevant certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, GIAC GSEC, CRISC, or equivalent) is an strong asset

  

EXPERIENCE:

  

* Minimum 5 years of progressive experience in creating, implementing, and maintaining Information Security management programs with a broad range of platforms and technologies
* In-depth knowledge of Information Security controls applicable for web applications, cloud, IoT, mobile applications, networks, and servers
* Minimum 3 years experience performing security assessments of infrastructure (cloud and on-premises), applications and websites
* Minimum 3 years experience working with vulnerability management lifecycle concepts (discovery, scanning, validation, prioritization, remediation tracking) and CVSS/exploitability-based scoring (e.g., EPSS); ability to interpret output from vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7) and attack surface management / cyber security posture management tools (e.g. Falcon, etc.)
* Understanding of Information Security and Risk Management frameworks like ISO27001, ISO27005, NIST CSF and NIST 800-30
* Deep understanding of exposure management and external attack surface management processes
* Experience in grouping individual vulnerabilities and risks for overall reporting purposes
* Experience in threat monitoring and threat intelligence
* Familiarity with legal and regulatory requirements like PCI-DSS, PIPEDA, PHIPA, GDPR etc

  

SKILLS:

  

* Able to think strategically about change and new solutions
* Strong writing, communication, presentation and interpersonal skills with the ability to produce high quality, comprehensive communications materials and articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong leadership and problem-solving skills
* Ability to prioritize and reprioritize work as required
* Adept at conforming to shifting priorities, demands and timelines
* Ability to work both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Proficiency with data analytics and data aggregation; experience with BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and basic scripting (Python, PowerShell) is an asset
* Thirst for knowledge, self-education, and research
* Strong organizational skills in planning and task coordination

  

OTHER:

  

Ability to work under pressure of high volume and expectations, while meeting multiple deadlines for multiple projects; strong service orientation coupled with ability to recognize and assess the operational significance of a problem, control/mitigate the risk, and set priorities accordingly. Strong ability to assess risks and controls of computing systems and operations. Demonstrated broad knowledge of information technology, instructional technology, classroom technology, audiovisual technologies, digital signage, network technologies, databases, and application development. Strong ability and willingness to work effectively as a team leader and team member; must be able to collaborate and cooperate with team members, project sponsors, other stakeholders. Ability to lead team members of varying levels and skill sets including Professional/Managerial as well as staff. Must be able to deal calmly and effectively with a variety of people. Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, tact, and diplomacy. Ability to effectively navigate a professional and political climate including assessing the requirement to escalate and issue to more senior levels of management or resources or bodies outside the Faculty; ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality. Ability and willingness to learn new systems, technologies and project management methods and tools.

Lightspeed is seeking a **Senior Staff Portfolio Operations Manager** to join our Product & Technology Operations team.

This is a **senior individual contributor** role suited to someone who brings experience in software product development, strong business judgment, and the ability to influence senior leaders, challenge assumptions, and drive change without relying on formal authority.

**Location:** Lightspeed is currently seeking **candidates based in Canada**. Candidates in Canada but residing outside the Eastern Time Zone must be flexible and willing to adjust their working hours as needed to accommodate EST-based collaboration and business requirements.

**What you'll be doing:**

  + Lead Product Operations for Hospitality during the initial six-month assignment, establishing the ways of working needed to support effective product development and delivery.
  + Partner with Hospitality Product & Technology leaders on roadmap planning and execution, managing priorities, dependencies, and delivery risks.
  + Establish planning and reporting cadences that provide visibility into progress, emerging issues, and decisions required.
  + Identify opportunities to improve how teams plan, communicate, and execute against priorities, breaking down silos and strengthening cross-functional collaboration.

  + Partner with Product Operations leads and vertical leaders to resolve shared challenges, build alignment, and coordinate action.

  + Establish consistent go-to-market handoff processes across Hospitality, Retail, and Financial Services while accommodating each vertical's needs.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex programs or portfolios, including prioritization, resource allocation, cross-functional dependencies, risks, and business outcomes across multiple teams.
* Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience developing portfolio reporting, dashboards, financial models, and investment tracking to support business decisions and evaluate trade-offs.
* Proven ability to translate complex data and business performance insights into actionable recommendations that inform strategic priorities, investment decisions, and operational improvements.
* Experience partnering with and influencing senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, building alignment, challenging assumptions, and driving decisions without relying on formal authority.
* Strong business judgment and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently identify opportunities, anticipate challenges, and drive initiatives forward in ambiguous environments.
* Experience improving operational processes, governance, and ways of working within a complex technology organization, balancing strategic priorities with hands-on execution.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts, adapt messaging to different audiences, and build trusted relationships across Product, Technology, Finance, and other business functions.
* A collaborative and empathetic approach, with the ability to understand different team perspectives, navigate competing priorities, and develop practical solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes.

Paralucent is seeking a Senior Delivery Manager to lead a multi-workstream enterprise modernization program in financial services. You will turn an established future-state vision into an executable roadmap, coordinate business and technology teams, manage dependencies and controls, and guide incremental releases through testing, approval, deployment and stabilization.

This role is for a hands-on leader who creates clarity, raises risks early and keeps teams focused on measurable outcomes.

* Own the integrated delivery plan across business process, user experience, workflow/case management, integrations, AI/document intelligence, security, testing and release workstreams.
* Translate program outcomes into increments, milestones, release plans, dependencies, decision points and acceptance evidence.
* Operate within an Agile or hybrid enterprise delivery model, including backlog readiness, sprint/release planning, demonstrations, retrospectives and production governance.
* Maintain disciplined RAID, decision, change, action and dependency management; surface material issues early with options and recommendations.
* Coordinate architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, records management, Responsible AI, operations and production-readiness reviews.
* Manage client and Paralucent governance, status reporting, financial tracking, forecasting, resource planning and milestone acceptance.
* Ensure requirements-to-test-to-evidence traceability and that no prototype is represented as production-ready.
* Plan cutover, pilot, hypercare, transition-to-support and progressive knowledge transfer.
* Create a high-accountability team environment with clear owners, due dates and escalation paths.

* A credible integrated plan, governance cadence and decision model are operating early.
* Milestones are achieved with transparent scope, budget, quality and risk reporting.
* Dependencies on enterprise teams and legacy-system owners are identified before they block delivery.
* Working end-to-end increments reach pilot and production with complete approval and test evidence.
* Operational teams are prepared to adopt, support and improve the solution after launch.

* 8+ years leading enterprise software, digital transformation or workflow/case-management delivery, including several years in senior delivery or program leadership.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex solutions into production in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Strong command of Agile delivery, release planning, dependency management, change control, financial management and executive reporting.
* Experience coordinating architecture, security, privacy, records, compliance, operations and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, distributed teams and cross-functional workstreams without losing end-to-end accountability.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including concise executive reporting and difficult escalation conversations.
* Practical understanding of cloud applications, enterprise integration, workflow, AI governance and production-readiness controls.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Canadian banking environments and enterprise risk/governance processes.
* Experience delivering high-volume operational workflow, document-processing or regulated case-management solutions.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe or comparable delivery certification.
* Experience using EOS-style scorecards, clear seat accountability and issue-solving disciplines.

*Final targets and cadence will be confirmed for the specific assignment. Typical measures include:*

* Milestone predictability and release readiness
* Budget and capacity variance
* Age and closure rate of critical RAID items
* Decision and dependency turnaround
* Defect escape and production-stability trends
* Stakeholder confidence and acceptance timeliness
* Knowledge-transfer and operational-readiness completion

**Driven:** Moves important work forward, recovers quickly from blockers and focuses on meaningful outcomes.

**Takes Ownership:** Closes loops, communicates risks early and remains accountable across handoffs.

**Creative Problem Solver:** Clarifies the real problem and proposes practical options with trade-offs.

**Humbly Confident:** Brings sound judgment, explains reasoning and actively invites challenge and feedback.

**Customer Centric:** Understands operational reality, success measures and the impact of decisions on users and the institution.

Title: IT Operations Lead
Description:
***About SJC***

*SJC*
stands as Canada’s largest privately owned communications company, distinguished by its portfolio of leading media brands, including Toronto Life, Chatelaine, and Maclean’s. At SJC, creativity, technology and journalism intersect to deliver content that resonates and performs. From integrated creative studios and advanced ad-tech to a portfolio of iconic media brands, we craft and distribute award-winning stories for audiences and advertisers alike. Partnering with organizations across North America, we build marketing solutions that inform, inspire and empower on every platform—from print to emerging digital channels. Our influence—and a 22-year streak on Canada’s Best Managed Companies list—reflects a culture committed to excellence and constant evolution. To learn more about our organization, please visit www.stjoseph.com

***About the Role***

Our IT team is seeking an IT Operations Lead to manage the people and systems that keep our infrastructure, network, and endpoints secure, reliable, and well maintained. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage and grow a small IT team while remaining hands-on as our Tier 3 escalation point for the more complex issues that come up day to day. The role touches on-prem server administration, networking, cloud infrastructure, and endpoint management, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity readiness—including planning and running tabletop exercises that stress-test our incident response. We're also looking for someone who brings an automation-first mindset, encouraging the use of AI tools and scripting to reduce manual toil across on-prem and cloud environments. You'll work closely with the Director, Engineering & Technology and other stakeholders across the business to set IT priorities, develop your team, and keep our people prepared for whatever comes next.

***What You'll Do in this Role:***

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small IT team, setting priorities, running performance and growth conversations, and building the team's on-call and incident response capabilities.
* Own Tier 3 escalations: stepping in on the trickier infrastructure, networking, and security issues that Tier 1/2 support can't resolve.
* Oversee on-prem server infrastructure, corporate networking, cloud infrastructure and identity, and endpoint management, ensuring these are reliable, secure, and well maintained (working with vendors or MSPs where deep specialist support is needed).
* Champion the organization's cybersecurity posture, including access management, patching cadence, and backup/recovery practices.
* Plan and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test and improve incident response readiness across IT and the broader business.
* Enforce support standards and processes and hold the team accountable to them.
* Assist the Director in evaluating external vendors and managed service providers.
* Encourage and guide the adoption of AI tools and automation/scripting to streamline IT operations, user management, and security monitoring.
* Collaborate with production, facilities, and business stakeholders to support office and infrastructure needs.
* Ensure documentation, systems, and runbooks are kept current to support consistency and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Other duties as assigned.

***Our ideal candidate:***

* Experienced IT generalist with solid working knowledge of on-prem server environments and enterprise networks, and a genuine interest in staying hands-on with day-to-day technical problems.
* Proven team-lead experience coaching and developing IT staff; 1-2+ years management experience. 4+ years contributing consistently on modern IT teams.
* Some hands-on exposure to cybersecurity practices, and comfortable planning or facilitating tabletop exercises and incident response discussions.
* Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure and identity/access management concepts (provisioning/deprovisioning, access reviews, conditional access).
* Comfortable overseeing endpoint fleets (Windows/MacOS) with the help of standard endpoint management tools.
* Enthusiastic about using AI tools and automation/scripting to make IT operations more efficient, even if not a deep scripting expert.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical risk and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
* Comfortable with balancing hands-on Tier 3 work with people management, planning, and strategic responsibilities.

***Your Skills Include:***

* On-prem & networking: General comfort administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments and troubleshooting LAN/WAN, VPN, and firewall issues.
* Cloud & identity: Working knowledge of a major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and identity/access tools (e.g., Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO).
* Endpoint management: Familiarity with common endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, JAMF, SCCM) for provisioning and securing devices.
* Cybersecurity: General understanding of incident response planning, tabletop exercise facilitation, and security best practices.
* AI & automation: Interest and some experience in using AI tools or scripting/automation platforms to streamline IT operations.
* Service management: Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools, SLA design, and Tier 1–3 support structures.
* People leadership: Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring, or leading IT staff, including performance management and team development.
* Education: A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

Equality and respect for all is one of our founding values and core beliefs at SJC. We are a diverse group with associates of all ages, orientations, races and talents. Title: Senior Project Manager

Title: CIAM Operations Support Lead
Description:
Requisition ID: 278669
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.
  
  
If you are passionate about Site Reliability Engineering and Software Operations Management with a strong technical mindset, keen interest in authentication and security, and thrive in a fast-moving environment - this is the position for you!
  
  
**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

* Lead CIAM SecDevOps and Operations, ensuring secure, consistent, automated, resilient, and scalable deployment and production support models.
* Lead the development, orchestration, security integration, and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and SecDevOps automation frameworks.
* Embed security-by-design and shift-left security practices across the CI/CD lifecycle, including automated code, dependency, vulnerability, configuration, and security scanning.
* Oversee the development and continuous improvement of CIAM observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational health frameworks.
* Manage the CIAM operations and production support team; optimise workflows and mentor direct reports to maximise business, security, and technical effectiveness.
* Manage escalations and production incidents, adapting established procedures and approaches to specific situations, including 24x7 production support, incident response, service restoration, and recovery coordination.
* Own and continuously enhance SecDevOps processes, engineering standards, automation, security controls, and operational practices.
* Build and maintain production monitoring and observability frameworks leveraging tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow.
* Drive proactive vulnerability remediation, software currency, security hardening, patching, and configuration compliance across CIAM platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for Linux-based environments, including RHEL, covering administration, troubleshooting, patching, security hardening, performance analysis, automation, and production support.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Scotiabank IT risk, security, regulatory, governance, and compliance requirements.
* Lead by example to develop operational plans, engineering standards, and procedures that improve time-to-market, security posture, service availability, resilience, and system reliability.
* Measure and optimise system performance, availability, security, and operational health to continuously improve CIAM capabilities.
* Participate in defining and managing SLIs, SLOs and SLAs for enterprise CIAM services.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for CIAM SecDevOps, guiding teams through SecDevOps maturity, automation, cloud adoption, identity security, vulnerability management, and secure engineering best practices.
* Partner with application development and engineering teams to investigate production issues, identify root causes, remediate security vulnerabilities, and safely deploy fixes.
* Work closely with Scotiabank infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, network, database, and platform teams to maintain CIAM infrastructure and deliver infrastructure upgrades, security remediation and software currency initiatives.
* Provide production support and escalation during business and off-hours. Apply sound and rapid judgement to incidents and security events, recommending workarounds or permanent resolutions that minimise service disruption and unplanned production outages.
* Perform risk assessments, security reviews, vulnerability assessments, and control reviews for CIAM implementations and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, security designs, configuration guides, operational procedures, support playbooks, and recovery documentation.
* Establish effective working relationships across business, cybersecurity, infrastructure, architecture, application development, programme, and project management teams.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture apply to day-to-day engineering, security, operational, and technology decisions.
* Champion a customer-focused and security-first engineering culture, fostering collaboration across business, security, infrastructure, and technology teams.
* Champion a high-performance, accountable, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

**Skills**
**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

* 7+ years of experience as an Operations lead, SecDevOps/DevOps Lead, SRE Lead, Engineering Lead, or equivalent role within a large enterprise product or platform team.
* 7+ years of experience in application engineering, deployments, security, and production support for large, complex, highly available enterprise systems.
* Strong experience with Linux/Unix platforms, preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), including system administration, troubleshooting, patching, security hardening, performance analysis, shell scripting, and production support.
* Strong understanding of Linux security concepts, including file permissions, service management, certificates, TLS configuration, system logs, vulnerability remediation, and operating-system hardening.
* Experience with cloud and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and PCF, particularly in building secure, automated, self-service platforms.
* Sound knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, load balancing, proxies, certificates, and the OSI model.
* Strong understanding of multi-tier applications, distributed systems, microservices architectures, containerised workloads, and cloud-hosted software stacks.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience creating and managing CI/CD or SecDevOps pipelines to build, scan, test, package, and deploy applications across production and pre-production environments.
* Hands-on experience integrating security controls and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines, supporting a shift-left security model.
* 5+ years of experience with configuration-management and Infrastructure-as-Code technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Chef, or Puppet.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using technologies such as Python, Bash, Java, and Ansible.
* Experience with enterprise CI/CD and engineering toolchains such as Jenkins, Gradle, Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Jira.
* Strong experience with vulnerability management, security remediation, software currency, patch management, certificate/TLS management, and platform security hardening.
* Strong working knowledge of IAM/CIAM concepts, including authentication, authorisation, identity lifecycle management, privileged access, federation, and secure identity integrations.
* Strong experience with incident, problem, and change management, including implementation of monitoring, alerting, service recovery, root-cause analysis, and preventative remediation.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills for complex IAM, CIAM, Linux, infrastructure, security, and application integration issues.
* Strong understanding of security-by-design, least privilege, defence-in-depth, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, and risk-based security principles.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organisational, and time-management skills, with a strong work ethic and reliability.
* Ability to develop high-quality technical documentation, including architecture and security diagrams, configuration guides, operational procedures, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Experience developing communications, briefings, technical recommendations, and presentations for senior executives and technology leadership.
* Proven success working within a matrix organisation and leading or influencing cross-functional engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and business teams, including senior management.

Title: Digitalisation & Technology Manager
Description:
**Company Description**

Six Construct, a subsidiary of the BESIX Group, is the largest Belgian construction company operating in the Middle East. The company combines the efforts of a highly skilled workforce, along with strategic planning and innovative use of technology to overcome the most complex business challenges. Six Construct is a multi-services company that operates in the construction of commercial and residential buildings, sport and leisure facilities, infrastructure and marine-related projects. The company currently employs a workforce of approximately 4,000 in the Middle East, and a total of 10,000 worldwide.

 **Job Description**

**Why This Role Matters**

We are seeking a forward-thinking **Digital & Technology Manager** to drive the digital transformation agenda across our business. This role will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, and implementing innovative technologies that improve operational efficiency, project delivery, collaboration, and data-driven decision-making.

The successful candidate will play a key role in shaping our digital strategy, fostering a culture of innovation, and ensuring the effective adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, automation, advanced analytics, digital platforms, and construction technologies. The role will work closely with business leaders, operations teams, project teams, and external technology partners to create measurable business value.

**What You'll Drive**

* Shape the digital journey of the new construction company, defining how technology and data can support the company from start-up through its first project and subsequent growth.
* Embed digitalisation from Day 1, ensuring new processes are designed digitally rather than reproducing traditional construction processes and legacy ways of working.
* Continuously scout and evaluate modern technologies that could improve productivity, quality, collaboration, speed of delivery and decision-making, including AI, automation, mobile solutions, reality capture, BIM, data analytics and emerging construction technologies.
* Translate innovation into practical use cases, working directly with project and functional teams to identify pain points, test solutions and demonstrate measurable operational value.
* Build a culture of experimentation, enabling rapid pilots and proof-of-concepts while quickly stopping initiatives that do not demonstrate sufficient value.
* Create a connected digital environment, avoiding fragmented applications and information silos and ensuring that data can progressively become a business asset.
* Establish a scalable technology foundation capable of supporting the first project and evolving as the new Construction Company grows, without creating unnecessary complexity or legacy constraints.

Title: Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager
Description:
Job description:
  
  

**Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager**

We are a leading independent telecoms infrastructure company, with one of the most extensive tower portfolios across Africa and the Middle East. Our business model promotes tower infrastructure sharing and enables mobile network operators (MNOs) to deliver mobile connectivity more quickly, reliably, cost-effectively and with a lower carbon footprint. In turn, this supports the expansion and quality of mobile connectivity, driving sustainable development in our markets.

**What we do**

We build, acquire, lease-up and operate telecommunications towers that can accommodate and power the needs of multiple tenants. Our tenants are major mobile network operators (MNOs), and we serve them across nine high-growth markets: eight in Africa and Oman in the Middle East. Our purpose, mission and sustainable business strategy are underpinned by our values of integrity, partnership and excellence.

**Overview**

Reporting into the Operations & Performance Engineering function, you will develop, govern and improve Group operational asset lifecycle strategies for telecommunications infrastructure assets. You will help ensure strong operational performance, reliability, safety, QHSE compliance and long-term value across the asset portfolio.

Working with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Procurement, IT and Maintenance Partners, you will lead lifecycle planning, asset performance optimisation, change governance, capital investment planning and asset information management. You will use data-led decision-making and digital asset management to improve lifecycle costs, governance and engineering standards across the Group.

**Location:**
UAE or South Africa
  
**Travel:**
Approximately 6–12 times per year

**Role responsibilities**

As Group Operational Asset Lifecycle Manager, you will be responsible for:

* Developing Group lifecycle and governance strategies for power systems, shelters and associated infrastructure.
* Preparing and implementing long-term asset replacement, refurbishment and renewal plans.
* Establishing and governing asset refurbishment programmes across operating companies.
* Improving preventive, predictive and condition-based maintenance strategies to strengthen reliability and extend asset life.
* Optimising total cost of ownership, return on invested capital and asset utilisation through effective lifecycle investment decisions.
* Owning the Group Asset Change Governance process for engineering modifications, integrations, transfers, refurbishments, relocations and disposals.
* Establishing and improving the Group Asset Governance Framework, including asset ownership, approval authorities, engineering acceptance and retirement controls.
* Developing the annual maintenance CAPEX investment programme and prioritising work according to asset condition, criticality and operational risk.
* Monitoring and reporting asset health, reliability, utilisation and effectiveness, using analytics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Governing asset information standards and data quality across Group systems, including asset master data, serialisation, configuration records and technical documentation.

**Requirements for the role**

To succeed in the role, you will have:

* A degree in Engineering, Business, Asset Management or a related technical discipline.
* 7–10 years’ experience in telecommunications infrastructure or another asset-intensive industry.
* At least five years’ experience leading asset management, asset governance or engineering lifecycle management in a multi-site environment.
* Experience with enterprise asset management (EAM), lifecycle costing, asset master data governance and engineering change control.
* Experience in digital asset management, asset analytics and using data to inform lifecycle decisions.
* A background in telecommunications infrastructure, power systems or utilities.

**Desired skills and qualifications**

* ISO 55001 Asset Management qualification or experience applying its principles.
* IAM Certificate or Diploma.
* Certified Asset Management Assessor (CAMA) qualification.
* Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) qualification.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or PRINCE2 qualification.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.

**Benefits**

* Competitive basic salary
* Discretionary bonus
* Health insurance
* Life insurance

Please submit your application within four weeks of the advert being published.

Helios Towers is committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment. You and all job applicants will receive equal treatment regardless of age, disability, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief.
