Title: Manager
Description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
The Acceptance Solutions team is part of the Value-Added Services (VAS) organization and is responsible for enabling and growing acceptance products and services across the CEMEA region.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading Visa's acceptance localization strategy and execution across Central and Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (CEMEA. The role will drive the identification, prioritization, and delivery of localization requirements necessary to support domestic payment schemes, national payment infrastructure initiatives, local routing mandates, regulatory requirements, and market-specific acceptance needs.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as the CEMEA subject matter expert for card-present acceptance localization and will work closely with regulators, national payment companies, financial institutions, acquirers, processors, merchants, and internal Visa stakeholders to ensure Visa's in-person acceptance capabilities support local market requirements and evolving payment ecosystem needs.
  
  
This role will partner extensively with Global Product teams, Core Processing and Network teams, Technology teams, Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, and Compliance organizations to assess market requirements, define product and processing enhancements, influence product roadmaps, and drive the delivery of localization initiatives across the acceptance ecosystem.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for developing regional localization strategies, conducting market and regulatory assessments, translating local requirements into actionable business and technical specifications, supporting client engagements, and ensuring successful deployment of localized acceptance capabilities across CEMEA markets.
  
  
This position would be ideal for a candidate with extensive experience in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance, payment processing, domestic payment schemes, regulatory programs, or in-person payments product management. The role is part of the hub team covering the CEMEA region and will report to the Acceptance Solutions Lead within the VAS organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for in-person acceptance localization across CEMEA, covering merchant acquiring, acceptance infrastructure, card-present payments, domestic payment schemes, and local routing initiatives.
* Lead Visa's regional strategy for localization of in-person acceptance capabilities to address regulatory requirements, domestic payment scheme mandates, and national payment infrastructure initiatives.
* Analyze and translate regulatory, market, and domestic scheme requirements into clearly documented business, operational, and technical requirements.
* Partner with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, and government stakeholders to understand evolving payment ecosystem requirements and represent Visa's acceptance capabilities.
* Work closely with Government Engagement, Legal, Risk, Compliance, and Regional Product teams to assess the impact of local payment requirements and define Visa's response strategy.
* Collaborate with Global Product, Technology, Acceptance Solutions, and Core Processing teams to build business cases, prioritize market requirements, and drive product roadmap enhancements.
* Partner with VisaNet, network processing, and core processing teams to evaluate technical implications of localization initiatives and identify scalable implementation approaches.
* Drive end-to-end execution of localization initiatives including requirements gathering, impact assessments, stakeholder alignment, business case development, delivery tracking, testing, certification support, and market readiness activities.
* Support domestic payment scheme enablement initiatives, including co-badging programs, local routing, domestic acceptance mandates, and national payment infrastructure projects.
* Assess acquiring, processing, and acceptance ecosystem readiness to support market-specific payment requirements.
* Engage with acquirers, processors, payment service providers (PSPs), payment facilitators, terminal vendors, merchants, fintechs, and ecosystem participants to understand implementation challenges and support deployment readiness.
* Identify product gaps and regional customization requirements and work with global teams to prioritize and deliver solutions addressing local market needs.
* Develop market assessments, strategy recommendations, and executive-level updates to support regional and global decision-making.
* Be responsible for annual planning activities for localization initiatives, including KPI setting, strategic priorities, delivery objectives, and cross-functional alignment.
* Monitor progress of localization programs and provide regular updates to senior leadership on market readiness, implementation status, risks, and dependencies.
* Represent Visa at industry forums, regulatory discussions, market working groups, and client engagements related to payment acceptance, domestic schemes, and localization initiatives.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in payments, merchant acquiring, card-present acceptance, payment processing, fintech, or related industries.
* Deep expertise in merchant acquiring, payment acceptance ecosystems, and card-present payment processing.
* Proven experience working with financial institutions, acquirers, processors, payment service providers, merchants, fintechs, payment networks, or national payment organizations.
* Strong knowledge of card-present payments, including:

+ EMV chip acceptance
+ Contactless payments
+ NFC technologies
+ SoftPOS / Tap-to-Phone
+ Android POS
+ Unattended commerce
+ Transit acceptance
+ Mobile wallet acceptance
+ QR-based acceptance solutions

* Strong understanding of payment processing and transaction lifecycles, including authorization, clearing, settlement, routing, switching, and acquiring architectures.
* Working knowledge of payment technologies and standards including ISO 8583, EMV specifications, contactless frameworks, tokenization concepts, terminal certification processes, and network routing models.
* Demonstrated experience supporting payment localization initiatives, domestic payment schemes, local routing programs, regulatory projects, or national payment infrastructure modernization efforts.
* Strong understanding of the payments landscape across GCC and broader CEMEA markets, including domestic schemes, regulatory frameworks, national payment infrastructure, and local routing requirements.
* Experience working with regulators, central banks, national payment companies, or government stakeholders is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with leading acquiring and payment processing platforms such as OpenWay, BPC, Compass Plus, ACI, Fiserv, or equivalent solutions is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to translate market requirements into product, technology, and operational deliverables.
* Experience driving complex cross-functional programs involving business, product, technology, legal, regulatory, and external stakeholders.
* Strong business acumen and ability to develop business cases and strategic recommendations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and program management skills.
* Ability to communicate complex technical and business concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives in a fast-paced and highly matrixed environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior executives, clients, regulators, and industry partners.
* Excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills to support strategy development, business cases, executive communications, and market assessments.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and Arabic.
* Ability to travel across GCC and CEMEA markets as required.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Title: Business Development Manager - Jeeny Ads

Jeeny is a leading ride-hailing platform that strives to revolutionize daily commuting and transportation. Our app connects users with their preferred modes of transportation, making mobility accessible, convenient, and affordable for all.

We are a joint venture between MEIG (Middle East Internet Group), Rocket Internet, and IMENA. Since our inception, we have grown exponentially and currently operate in Saudi Arabia and Jordan.

This is a high-impact **Individual Contributor (IC)** role for a strong “hunter” who can build relationships, win new business, and aggressively grow advertising revenue.

* Have many careers in one Firm.
* Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
* Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

**What will your typical day look like?**
As a Senior Manager in our ServiceNow managed services business, you will lead the delivery of ongoing application management services for one or more of our clients. You will be accountable for building trusted client relationships, providing leadership to our delivery teams, and making sure we consistently deliver on our commitments.
  
  
You will work closely with client executives and operational leaders to understand their priorities, assess how their ServiceNow environment is performing, and identify opportunities to improve service quality, platform adoption and business outcomes. You will lead regular service reviews, communicate progress, manage issues and risks, and provide practical recommendations that help clients get more value from their investment in ServiceNow. Finding ways to innovate and bring additional value to your clients will be a key factor to your success.
  
  
You will manage Deloitte’s people, processes, and commercial performance of your engagements. This includes building effective teams, developing and coaching our personnel, ensuring high quality delivery practices, managing financial performance, and ensuring that contractual commitments are understood and met. When challenges arise, you will bring the right people together, help the team work through the problem and maintain clear, open communication with the client.
  
  
You will also play a meaningful role in growing our ServiceNow business. You will identify opportunities with existing and prospective clients, shape managed services solutions, lead proposals and presentations, and work with your colleagues to bring the best of Deloitte to the market.
  
  
Beyond individual client engagements, you will contribute to the development of our practice. This may include evolving our delivery methods and service offerings, developing reusable assets, supporting recruitment, building alliances and internal relationships, contributing to market perspectives, and strengthening our ServiceNow community across Canada and globally.
  
  
No two days will be exactly the same. You can expect a role that is highly collaborative, client-facing and commercially focused, with the opportunity to lead important services, develop talented teams and help shape a growing part of our business. Your role will include both managing service delivery, and pursuing sales opportunities.
  
  
**About The Team**
This is an opportunity to join Deloitte’s ServiceNow managed services practice. We help clients run, maintain and continually improve their ServiceNow platforms after implementation, combining deep platform knowledge with strong service management, industry and business experience.
  
  
Our work goes beyond keeping the platform operational. We work alongside our clients to improve how services are delivered, respond to changing business needs, introduce new capabilities and create sustained value from ServiceNow. Our teams bring together functional, technical, industry and service delivery skills to support complex organizations and their users.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative Canadian practice connected to Deloitte’s broader national and global capabilities. You will work with leaders and specialists across service lines, industries and geographies to develop solutions that are practical, scalable and tailored to each client.

* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, managing, selling, architecting and delivering ServiceNow services.
* Experience leading ServiceNow managed services, application support. Experience across both ServiceNow implementation and ongoing support environments is a plus.
* Proven ability to lead teams, including resources working across multiple locations and delivery centers, with an ability to grow a high-performance team through coaching and development.
* Strong client relationship skills and experience working directly with senior business and technology clients. Ability to develop long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Demonstrated success in business development and sales, including identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, developing proposals and statements of work, participating in RFP responses, and presenting managed services offerings to clients.

* Bilingualism in English and French is considered a strong asset but is not required for this position.

Description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759846

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY’s Canada Tax & Law Technology Group (CTTG) is seeking an experienced Associate Director / Senior Manager, Data Strategy & Data-Enabled Solutions to help define and scale our data strategy, capabilities, offerings, and solutions.

  

This is a strategic and hands-on role that will play a pivotal part in shaping how data is leveraged as a strategic asset across Tax & Law. The role will focus on identifying new opportunities, enabling data-driven insights and decision-making, developing new solutions and services, strengthening existing offerings, and enabling smarter and more scalable service delivery.

We are looking for a senior data professional who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. The successful candidate will be expected to help set direction while also working directly with data to explore opportunities, develop analyses, test hypotheses, prototype solutions, and evaluate new approaches and technologies. They will leverage CTTG development and delivery resources to help engineer, productionize, and scale solutions where needed.

  

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Partner with Tax & Law leadership to define and execute a data strategy that advances service delivery, managed services, growth, and new market offerings, including opportunities to connect data and insights across competencies and services.

The successful candidate will bring a strong background in data strategy, analytics, data architecture, and hands-on solution development, and will operate as a connector between business leadership, data and technology teams, and solution delivery. **What we look for**

Title: Head of BFSI
Description:
**Who we are**  
  
ML arteka is one of the fastest-growing IT Services and Consulting companies in Canada and serves some of the most iconic brands, including Google, Loblaws, Staples, Telus, Bell, Rogers, CIBC, BMO, CMLS, Fossil, Fitbit and more.  
  
Over the last decade, we have achieved 100% client retention and earned more than 20 notable industry recognition. This reflects our reliability in delivering what we promise and the quality we bring to every engagement.  
  
Join our growth-driven culture and help us lead, innovate, and simplify. We are looking for a team members who embody our values:

* Empathetic - we listen, we understand, and are considerate of everyone
* Persevering - we don't give up on challenges or people and go all the way
* Inclusive - we value everyone and their perspectives
* Reliable - we deliver what we promise, and more
* Innovative - we make things better than they were yesterday

  

**The role**  
  
We are seeking a Head of BFSI to **originate and grow** our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business across Canada and the United States. This is a **consultative business development leadership** role designed for a senior professional who combines deep BFSI domain expertise with strong technology acumen and the ability to build trusted executive relationships.  
  
You will create a pipeline by engaging BFSI executives on their modernization agenda, shaping opportunities into structured offers (**POV/assessment MVP scale**), and converting those into multi-year programs. You will partner closely with Sales for commercial execution and with internal practice leaders (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) for solution depth and delivery confidence.  
  
This is not transactional selling. Revenue is generated through credibility, insight, and advisory-led origination—not volume outreach or RFP chasing.

  
**Why** **ML arteka****?**  
  
**Most senior BFSI leaders don’t lack ideas—they lack room to act.**

* Room to move faster than RFP cycles and internal red tape. Room to turn executive conversations into funded modernization programs. Room to own outcomes, not activity.

**At** **ML arteka****, this role is built for people who think:**

* “I can build more pipeline if I’m not boxed into bureaucracy.”
* “BFSI buyers need a modernization partner, not another vendor.”
* “I want accountability for conversion—assessment MVP scale—not just meetings.”
* “I want to build a durable BFSI portfolio, not manage accounts.”

**Originate, Don’t Just Network**

* This isn’t about collecting contacts. It’s about creating demand—shaping modernization triggers into structured offers and multi-year programs.

**Operate Like an Owner**

* You’ll have autonomy to build the BFSI growth motion: target accounts, executive coverage, positioning, and deal shaping—partnering with practices and Sales to make programs defensible and repeatable.

**Move Fast, Keep Rigor**

* BFSI modernization demands speed and discipline (risk, compliance, security, resilience). If slow decision cycles frustrate you, you’ll find this environment refreshing and demanding—in the right way.

**A Place for Builders**

* Not for narrow lanes or comfort-first roles. If you want to build a BFSI growth engine and leave a mark, ML arteka is the platform.

**Why This Role Exists**  
  
BFSI enterprises are under unprecedented pressure to modernize:

* Core platforms and legacy applications
* Data estates and analytics foundations
* Risk, compliance, and regulatory capabilities
* Cloud and infrastructure operating models
* AI adoption across fraud, risk, operations, and customer experience

Despite heavy investment, many initiatives stall due to lack of clarity, fragmented execution, and misalignment between business and technology.  
Our firm exists to help BFSI organizations modernize with clarity, control, and measurable outcomes. The Head of BFSI will translate this mission into a sustainable, repeatable **growth engine**.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**1) Consultative Origination & Pipeline Ownership**

* Own BFSI growth by building pipeline through **executive discovery** and problem-led conversations.
* Develop and maintain a **target account plan** (named accounts, buying centers, modernization triggers, stakeholder maps).
* Identify high-impact BFSI challenges and translate them into structured engagements:
  + POVs and executive workshops
  + Assessments and roadmaps
  + MVPs / pilots
  + Multi-year modernization programs
* Sponsor the progression of clients from **assessment MVP scale**, ensuring opportunities are capability-led and repeatable—not opportunistic.
* Act as executive sponsor on strategic deals and long-term programs; partner with Sales on pursuit orchestration and commercial closure.
* Maintain pipeline hygiene: stage quality, next steps, close plans, and predictable coverage.

**2) Executive Coverage & Relationship Development**

* Serve as the outward-facing BFSI leader and build trusted relationships with:
  + CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs
  + Heads of Risk, Compliance, Operations, Digital, and Data
* Engage clients as a thought partner and modernization advisor; convert executive alignment into funded programs.
* Represent the firm at BFSI events, conferences, and executive forums.
* Lead and contribute to BFSI thought leadership (POVs, whitepapers, panels, roundtables).

**3) Territory/Account Strategy & Growth Plays**

* Define and own the BFSI market strategy for your region/territory.
* Identify priority lines of business, such as:
  + Retail & Commercial Banking
  + Payments & Cards
  + Capital Markets
  + Wealth & Asset Management
  + Insurance
  + Risk, Compliance, and Financial Crime
* Develop BFSI-specific value propositions and use cases aligned to enterprise modernization priorities.
* Shape a BFSI-focused, capability-led GTM model in partnership with practice leaders and Sales.

**4) Deal Shaping (Assessment MVP Scale)**

* Lead discovery with BFSI clients; translate business and regulatory challenges into technology-enabled modernization programs.
* Sponsor and guide solution shaping across:
  + Modernization assessments and roadmaps
  + Data and AI readiness initiatives
  + Platform, cloud, and infrastructure transformation programs
* Partner closely with internal practices (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) to ensure solutions are outcome-driven, realistic, and defensible.
* Ensure pricing and estimation are disciplined; protect margin integrity by validating assumptions, scope, and delivery approach.

**5) Offering Influence & Differentiation**

* Influence the development of BFSI offerings and accelerators that improve repeatability, win-rate, and conversion to multi-year programs.
* Ensure solutions reflect BFSI expectations:
  + Regulatory rigor
  + Enterprise-scale complexity
  + Risk, governance, security, and resilience
* Stay current on BFSI modernization drivers, regulatory trends, and AI adoption challenges.

**6) Ecosystem & Partner Engagement**

* Leverage technology and platform partners selectively to accelerate credible wins.
* Participate in joint GTM and co-sell motions where they support BFSI growth goals.
* Maintain independence and objectivity—partner-aware, not partner-led.

**Measures of Success (What “Good” Looks Like)**

* Predictable BFSI pipeline sourced through executive discovery and modernization triggers
* Strong conversion from **POV/assessment MVP multi-year program**
* Growing average deal size and increased share of multi-year modernization engagements
* Deep executive coverage within priority accounts (multiple senior stakeholders)
* Clear differentiation from implementation-only firms through insight, repeatability, and defensible programs

  
**Who You Are**  
  
**Experience**

* 15+ years in Banking, Financial Services, and/or Insurance
* Proven record **originating** revenue through advisory relationships and consultative engagement
* Strong background in enterprise technology modernization (data, cloud, platforms, security, AI)
* Demonstrated ability to influence and sell to senior BFSI executives
* Track record of converting executive conversations into structured, funded programs

**Attributes (Non-Negotiable)**

* Hybrid consultant + technologist + commercial leader
* Naturally curious and deeply informed about BFSI challenges
* Comfortable owning growth without transactional selling
* Strong executive presence and storytelling ability
* Well-respected in the BFSI ecosystem
* Entrepreneurial mindset; comfortable with ambiguity
* Outward-facing personality—people enjoy engaging with and learning from you

**What You Won’t Be Doing**

* Not a transactional sales role focused on volume outreach
* Not primarily RFP-response driven
* Not a delivery management role (delivery execution is owned by practice and delivery leaders)

**Travel & Location**  
  
Based in Canada (or the United States). Willingness to travel for client engagements, industry events, and executive meetings.  
  
**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to build and own a BFSI growth engine through consultative origination
* Platform to establish your industry voice and thought leadership
* Strong alignment with AI-era enterprise modernization
* Entrepreneurial environment with executive influence
* Ability to shape offerings, solutions, and market narrative

  
**What to expect**  
  
Besides Competitive Salary and working for one of Canadas Best Managed and Top 50 Technology Companies, you should expect:

* Purposeful Work: autonomy, resources, and time you need to do what matters for our clients and most importantly - you
* Positive Environment: recognition coupled with a flexible environment that celebrates diversity, inclusivity and encourages everyone to achieve their best
* Growth & Development: opportunities to grow professionally and personally through mentorship, training, and development programs
* Transparency & Trust: direction, purpose, mission, and expectations are never a secret; you will always know where you stand as well as where you are going
* Exclusive Perks: discounts on shopping, the gym, insurance, mobile phone plans, not to mention an office smoothie bar and enough coffee to make you vibrate
* Meaningful Benefits: life happens. You will get health, dental, vision, disability, travel insurance, and much more all covered by us
* Unforgettable Events: team bonding, BBQs, office lunches (pizza, always pizza), gala dinners, and any other excuse to have fun

**Inclusion and equal opportunity employment**  
  
ML arteka is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status, or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodation during the application process is available upon request.

The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead is responsible for managing, processing, and analyzing utility infrastructure data collected in the field for electric utility programs. This role supports pole inventory, joint-use audits, and distribution system mapping initiatives by transforming field-collected data into accurate datasets used for engineering design, asset management, and utility planning.

* Track project progress and field data submission status.

  
**Data Processing & Analysis**

* Process field data within Katapult Pro workflows including pole modeling, attachment identification, and field verification review.
* Validate field photos and measurements to ensure pole loading analysis requirements are met.

  
**Pole Inventory & Joint-Use Analysis**

* Review pole inventory data to confirm attachment ownership and pole characteristics.
* Analyze joint-use attachment data including telecommunications and cable infrastructure.

  + Katapult Pro

  + GIS systems

* Perform quality checks on incoming field data including photo documentation, GPS data, and asset attributes.
* Identify discrepancies or missing data and coordinate corrections with field crews.
* Ensure deliverables meet internal QC standards and client specifications.

  
**Project Coordination**

* Work closely with Project Managers to ensure project schedules and deliverables are met.
* Provide technical support to field crews collecting pole inventory data.
* Review incoming field data daily to identify missing attributes, incorrect measurements, or documentation gaps.
* Coordinate data corrections and re-collection when necessary.

  
**Qualifications**

* 2+ years experience processing utility data, GIS datasets, or pole inventory/joint-use programs.
* Experience supporting electric utility infrastructure projects preferred.
* Experience working with pole inventory or joint-use datasets highly preferred.
* An educational background in Land Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field is preferred.

The GIS Technician II - Utility Pole Program Lead works in the office, providing technical support and leadership in surveying operations. This role involves data processing and collaboration with survey teams.

Title: Facility Manager
Description:

Traditional retail models, built around brick-and-mortar locations, often struggle to compete in today's digital-first landscape. Challenges such as cost efficiency per square foot, logistics-optimized locations, and seamless technology integration have made it clear that a new approach is needed.

We believe the future of foodservice and commerce lies in purpose-built infrastructure designed for speed, accuracy, and scalability. That's why Namaa was established—to power the next generation of digital food and quick commerce ecosystems across the Middle East.

Description:

Experience, skills and competencies are the guidelines for selecting our best candidates. Would you like to join our team?

  
  

**Position:**
-------------

The CDE Manager will be responsible for the administration and governance of the Common Data Environment (CDE) for the Program/Interface Support Consultant (PISC) services of the PIF client Riyadh programme, ensuring that all programme information, models and deliverables are shared, reviewed, published and archived in a structured, secure and traceable manner, in line with ISO 19650 and the Client’s requirements.

The Role will ensure the integration between the CDE, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Coreworx, so that design outputs, Interface Control Forms (ICF), Interface Close-out Certificates (ICC) and supporting evidence are fully traceable throughout the programme lifecycle.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Administer the Client-designated CDE (expected to be Aconex) for the PISC team, including folder structures, naming conventions, status codes (WIP, Shared, Published, Archived), metadata and workflows, in line with the Client’s Systems Landscape.
* Contribute to the Gap Analysis Report on CDE processes and systems, identifying gaps and proposing improvements.
* Define and implement CDE workflows and procedures within the PISC BIM Execution Plan, aligned with the Client’s EIR and Programme-wide BIM Execution Strategy.
* Ensure that models, snapshots and documents referenced in ICFs and ICCs are published on the CDE with EDMS numbering and controlled revisions.
* Define the links between the CDE, Coreworx, Autodesk Construction Cloud, the federated model and the Master Data Set (common IDs, exports, integrations), avoiding parallel registers.
* Manage user accounts, roles and permissions for the PISC team and external parties on the CDE and ACC, in compliance with the Client’s cybersecurity, data governance and data residency requirements.
* Ensure that Field Design outputs are uploaded on the CDE with traceability to change control and interface closure.
* Support document control of PISC deliverables (Package Execution Plan, Gap Analysis Report, Data Validation Report, progress reports), including transmittals, submittals and review comments.
* Support the integration of the CDE with the Design Review Comment Trackers and the controlled distribution of published information to PMCs, LDCs and International Participants.
* Carry out periodic audits of information quality and compliance on the CDE and report CDE KPIs within the Category A progress reports.
* Support the technical specification, and training of software licences purchased on behalf of the Client.
* Deliver onboarding and training on CDE procedures and platforms, keeping attendance records.
* Support the handover of information (as-built, AIM, O&M data, interface close-out evidence) in line with contractual requirements.

Any additional related and similar activities consistent with the expertise required to complete assigned tasks.

**Job Knowledge**

* In-depth knowledge of ISO 19650 series and information management processes in BIM-enabled programs.
* Advanced knowledge of CDE and document management platforms, in particular Oracle Aconex and Autodesk Construction Cloud.
* Familiarity with interface management platforms (e.g. Coreworx) and with platform integration (APIs, data exports) is an advantage.
* Good understanding of document control, EDMS numbering, transmittal and approval workflows for design and construction programs.
* Good understanding of BIM processes, EIR, BEP, MIDP/TIDP and information delivery milestones.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel in particular); knowledge of reporting tools such as Power BI is preferred.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Information Management or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in information management, document control or CDE administration on large-scale infrastructure or building projects.
* Proven experience in implementing ISO 19650-compliant processes on multi-project programs or giga-projects.
* Previous experience on projects in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia or the GCC region is preferred.
* Experience in working within an international engineering or construction company is preferred.
* Professional certifications in ISO 19650 or Aconex/ACC are considered an asset.

**Personal Attributes**

* High attention to detail and strong focus on data quality and accuracy.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Well-organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks, stakeholders and deadlines.
* Proactive approach with the ability to identify risks and propose solutions early.
* Strong communication and coordination skills with multidisciplinary teams, clients and subcontractors.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure in fast-paced project environments.
* Availability to be based on site in Riyadh, in line with the project deployment plan, and to mobilize within short timeframes.
* Strong proficiency in English and Arabic is mandatory.

Description:

**Role:**
Lead Ingram Micro's global cloud support operations for AWS Partner-Led Support today, with other vendor lines to follow. When a customer's AWS production environment goes down, our team is who they call. Ingram Micro delivers AWS Partner-Led Support to end customers who buy AWS through our reseller partners, and you'll lead the global team that resolves their toughest issues. You'll lead senior engineers and Technical Account Managers across time zones, and you'll be the technical leader in the room on high-impact escalations: challenging assumptions, unblocking diagnosis and coordinating with customers, resellers and AWS. You'll also shape how we scale support through AI, automation and self-service.
  
  
**You'll stand out if**
you can walk us through an AWS incident you personally diagnosed: what you checked, what you ruled out and what fixed it. A distinguished leadership style overseeing a global team ranging from engineers, technical account managers, supervisors, and managers.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
**Lead and grow the team:**

* Lead senior engineers and Technical Account Managers across regions: hiring, coaching, performance, capacity planning and handoffs between time zones.
* Build leadership depth, succession and clear growth paths as the service expands to more vendors.

**Lead escalations and set the technical bar:**

* Provide technical direction for hih-impact incidents across AWS compute, storage, networking, identity, operating systems and databases in diverse end customer environments.
* Guide network troubleshooting across VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, DNS, load balancers, VPNs, and hybrid connectivity; distinguish connectivity, configuration, application, and AWS service issues.
* Guide database troubleshooting involving Amazon RDS/Aurora and database engines, including connectivity, query latency, resource bottlenecks, locking, replication, failover, and backup or recovery issues. Require evidence-based diagnosis using logs, metrics, configuration, and relevant diagnostic tools.

**Scale the service:**

* Introduce AI capabilities: agent copilots, conversational support, automated diagnostics and intelligent case routing.
* Build a knowledge base using Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) so customers and engineers resolve issues faster.
* Use support data and customer feedback to find recurring issues, and work with AWS, Product and Engineering to fix them at the source.

**Run the operation:**

* Own the metrics: mean time to resolution (MTTR), SLA compliance, backlog health, quality, customer satisfaction (CSAT) and self-service adoption.
* Present incidents, trends, risks and improvement plans to customer executives, partners and senior leadership.
* Lead cross-functional work with AWS, Product, Engineering, Sales and regional operations, often without direct authority.

**What success looks like in your first year:**

* Faster, more consistent resolution of customer incidents in every region.
* Escalations to AWS that are evidence-based and resolved sooner.
* AI and self-service tools reducing repeat cases.
* A team with clear standards, growth paths and a strong leadership bench.
* Cross functional handling across hardware/software and vendor lines.
* New vendor lines onboarded to the same operating standard.

**What you bring to the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 8+ years in technical support, cloud operations or IT services, including substantial hands-on troubleshooting in customers' AWS production environments.
* 3+ years of formal people management, including hiring, performance management and development.
* Experience leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.
* Practical AWS networking knowledge: VPCs, routing, security groups, network ACLs, DNS, load balancing, VPN and hybrid connectivity. You can trace a network path and isolate where it breaks.
* Practical database troubleshooting with Amazon RDS/Aurora and MySQL or PostgreSQL: connectivity, performance, locking, replication, availability and recovery.
* Working knowledge of EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, the AWS CLI and operating-system diagnostics.
* Experience leading teams across time zones and managing critical escalations in an enterprise, multifunctional environment.
* Must be able to communicate clearly and calmly with executives, particularly during high-pressure situations or incidents.
* Support leadership at an AWS partner, managed service provider, distributor or cloud support provider would be a strong asset.
* Multi-vendor technical support experience across cloud, networking or security would be an asset.
* Experience introducing AI support tools, automated diagnostics, KCS or self-service would be an asset.
* AWS certifications in architecture, operations or networking would be an asset.

**Director, IT Operations**

* Enterprise networking — operating cloud networks, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity between on-premises, cloud, and remote users

* Microsoft 365 services — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive

* Lead incident response and major incident command for IT services; drive post-incident reviews and ensure systemic remediation
* Operate mature ITSM practices (incident, problem, change, release) and continuously evolve them — moving routine change toward automated, pipeline-driven flow while preserving controls
* Operate resilient compute, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery in Microsoft Azure to the standards set by Cloud Engineering
* Run cloud networking, VPN, firewall operations, and secure connectivity between on-premises, cloud, and remote users
* Own operational readiness for new systems, applications, and platform changes — including go/no-go authority for production cutover
* Operate Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and RBAC in partnership with Security; own identity hygiene and lifecycle execution
* Ensure reliable, performant delivery of Microsoft 365 services across the enterprise
* Improve the employee IT experience through automation, self-service, and modern workplace tooling; measure it with experience-level metrics (XLAs), not just ticket SLAs
* Ensure reliable IT connectivity and service delivery for corporate and clinical operations
* Promote and operationalize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management in alignment with Cloud Engineering's standards
* Drive automation for provisioning, monitoring, patching, and routine operational tasks; measure and reduce manual toil
* Selectively adopt emerging automation and AI-assisted tooling where it materially improves reliability, response time, or employee experience
* Standardize platforms, reduce technical debt, and improve operational maturity over time
* Partner with Security to operationalize security controls, vulnerability management, and incident response
* Ensure IT operations meet HIPAA, HITRUST, and internal risk management requirements through evidenced, auditable practices
* Own operational evidence for audits — logging, access reviews, change records, and configuration baselines
* Drive FinOps practices across cloud and infrastructure platforms in partnership with Cloud Engineering
* Own the IT operations budget, forecasting, and vendor spend optimization
* Manage vendor and managed service provider relationships, including Microsoft
* Build, lead, and develop high-performing IT operations teams and managers; set career paths for operations engineers, SREs, and service managers
* Foster strong working relationships with Security, Applications, Data, and Business leadership

* Track record of partnering with cloud architecture and platform engineering leaders
* Experience driving automation and reducing manual toil through IaC and operational tooling
* Proficiency with FinOps, vendor management, and managed service provider experience
* Prior experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA/HITRUST a plus)
* Relevant Microsoft and/or ITSM certifications a plus

Title: Information Security Manager, Product & Platform Security
Description:
Full-Time

In Person: Boston, MA Headquarters

*Step into a pivotal* ***Security Leadership*** *role at a fast-growing grid intelligence company.*

LineVision’s customers include eight of the ten largest US utilities, which demand the highest levels of security in order to protect sensitive data and the electric grid from attack. You will lead LineVision to advance Product and Enterprise security to give customers confidence to rely on LineVision.

Reporting to the VP of Security, IT, and Quality, you will have broad autonomy over security engineering, security operations, controls execution, governance, and compliance. You and a Security Analyst will guide the security of our Products (AWS Platform, RS-1 optical and weather sensors) and Enterprise (SaaS platforms, IAM, endpoints, etc) across the full spectrum of security and compliance responsibilities, including annual SOC 2 Type II audits and ISO 27001 certifications, risk management, vulnerability management, incident response, penetration testing program, and customer security questionnaires. Partnering with IT, Platform, Hardware, and Customer Success, you will combine your vision and hands-on experience to build security into a strategic business advantage at LineVision.

If you want to build a security program that is seen as a strategic differentiator and wins customer trust, join us at **LineVision, Built In Boston Best Places to Work**!

Please note: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

### **Core Responsibilities and Key Performance Objectives**

* **Compliance Program Ownership**: Own the annual audit cycle for SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 using the Vanta compliance platform, including all controls, internal audits, external audits, and nonconformity tracking to closure.
* **Risk Management & Governance**: Lead the annual NIST CSF risk assessment, monthly Platform and Hardware risk reviews, and quarterly Governance, Risk & Compliance reviews. Maintain policies and report ISMS efficacy metrics to leadership.
* **Security Engineering**: Conduct AWS cloud and Sensor penetration tests, ISA/IEC 62443 product security assessments, vendor and product risk assessments.
* **Security Operations**: Oversee vulnerability management, CrowdStrike Falcon Complete detection rules, NextGen SIEM data feeds, and the MSSP relationship. Monitor open-source license compliance with FOSSA.
* **Incident Response & Resilience**: Own the incident response program and plan, including the annual 3rd part tabletop, business continuity and disaster recovery exercises, and implementation of lessons learned.
* **Confidential Data Protection**: Define and guide data management controls, ensuring rigorous application of policies and customer contractual obligations regarding confidential data. Partner with Platform, Hardware and IT to apply controls across all company systems and applications.
* **Customer & Sales Support**: Lead responses to customer security questionnaires, contract security reviews, and customer-facing security presentations and material.
* **AI Security:** Identify risks and define security standards for enterprise and product AI. Inform the AI governance program with risk assessments and recommendations.
* **Team Leadership**: Coach and develop the security team.
* Please note: This role may require participation in a compensated, rotational on-call schedule. Any on-call responsibilities would take effect after the onboarding period.

### **Current Projects**

**Within the first 3 months:**

* Establish operational rhythm with the security team, including 1-1s, goal-setting, and sprint planning.
* Take ownership of the audit calendar, risk register, and security project portfolio.
* Implement an intake and prioritization process for security work that surfaces trade-offs and schedule risk early.
* Take over customer security questionnaires and contract reviews, and build a reusable response library.
* Lead monthly security risk reviews.

**Within the first 6 months:**

* Deliver SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 surveillance audits with no major nonconformances.
* Complete an annual IEC 62443 security assessment of the product and track remediations.
* Apply controls over Confidential Data with the IT Lead across our Corporate Environment.
* Select and implement a Vulnerability Management tool to streamline detection, tracking and resolution across SCA, CSPM, SAST, DAST, and license compliance.
* Conduct penetration tests of our cloud environment and physical sensor.
* Plan and conduct a 3rd party incident response tabletop, and address findings.
* Mature CrowdStrike detection rules and SIEM coverage.

**Within the first year:**

* Propose a 2–3 year security roadmap that fulfills LineVision’s vision for security excellence, including tooling, budget, and resourcing as the company grows.
* Reduce questionnaire effort per customer through self-service trust materials and a mature answer library.
* Plan and conduct a purple team exercise against LineVision and address findings.
* Define security requirements for next-generation sensors and platform features.
* Establish ISMS efficacy metrics reported quarterly to leadership.
* Lead quarterly Governance, Risk & Compliance reviews with executive leadership.

**How to succeed in this role**
-------------------------------

**Key Competencies**

* **Ownership**: take full responsibility for the security program's outcomes, from audit results to customer confidence.
* **Planning & Prioritization:** absorb interrupt-driven work (questionnaires, incidents, audit requests) while keeping long-term projects on schedule, and raise a flag early when something must slip.
* **Communication**: explain risk clearly to engineers, executives, customers, and auditors; tailor the message to the audience.
* **Judgment**: make risk-based decisions that balance security with business velocity.
* **People Leadership:** develop direct and cross-functional team members and delegate meaningful ownership rather than doing the work yourself.

**Essential Skills**

* 6+ years in information security, with at least 2 years in a lead or people-management role.
* Direct ownership (not only support) of SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audits.
* Experience conducting risk assessments with NIST CSF or an equivalent framework.
* Hands-on experience with penetration test management, vulnerability management, and EDR/SIEM tooling (CrowdStrike preferred).
* Experience with AWS cloud security.
* Experience responding to enterprise customer security questionnaires and contract requirements.
* CISSP, or a commitment to earn it within 18 months of start date.

**What Sets The Best Candidates Apart**

* Experience with OT/ICS or IoT security, including IEC 62443.
* Familiarity with utility sector requirements (CEII, NERC CIP) or other regulated critical infrastructure.
* Experience leading incident response for a real event.
* Experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation.
* Experience in AI Governance and/or assessing the security of AI tools and features.

**Reporting & Team Structure**
------------------------------

* Reports to the VP of Security, IT & Quality.
* Manages the Security Analyst.
* Partners with the IT Lead on IT controls, identity, endpoint security, and CEII controls.
* Partners with Platform, DevOps, and Hardware teams on vulnerability remediation, SDLC evidence, and disaster recovery.
* Partners with Customer Success and Sales on customer security engagements, and with Legal on contract terms and incident response.

**What does joining LineVision mean for you?**
----------------------------------------------

* **Impact**. Your talent, time, and energy will critically impact our success in accelerating our mission of providing utilities with grid intelligence to enable affordable, reliable power.
* **Ownership**. You will hold broad responsibilities with high autonomy and trust in a communicative, collaborative, and fast-paced environment.
* **Flexibility**. You will be empowered to maintain work-life balance with trust-based PTO and a flexible work schedule.
* **Real World Innovation.** You will join a motivated and high-performing team working with cutting edge, patented technology to help solve key obstacles to meet the demands of an AI-powered future.

**Who we are…**
---------------

LineVision is a grid-enhancing technology company enabling electric utilities to deliver affordable, reliable power and accelerate the electrification of the global economy. Our grid intelligence platform delivers the most accurate, network-wide dynamic line ratings and enables safer, more reliable grid operations with a combination of optical sensors and advanced environmental modeling. LineVision's global customer base includes eight of the ten largest US utilities, including National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

**We are LineVisionaries:**
---------------------------

* **We are Innovators**: We light the way with tenacious creativity and do good work.
* **We are Empowered**: With high trust and high autonomy, the floor is yours, and the opportunity is ours.
* **We are Welcoming**: Come as you are, our doors are open. We are better together.
* **We are Trusted Partners**: We elevate our customer champions through shared thought leadership. We deliver on commitments.
* **We are All In**: We are building a community of passionate individuals who want to dent the universe.

At LineVision there’s no such thing as a "perfect" candidate. We are looking for exceptional people who want to make a positive impact through their work and facilitate an organization where everyone can thrive. So whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this role would make you excited to come to work every day.

LineVision embraces AI, and we understand leveraging AI in your job search. As an actual member of LineVision's hiring team reviews every application, we kindly ask that any final materials you submit reflect your own voice and authentic human experience.

**Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S.**

The base salary range for this role is $140,000-180,000 USD. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, education, and other relevant qualifications. This role is also eligible to participate in a company bonus plan. In addition to base salary, LineVision offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision and disability insurance, commuter benefits, a 401(k) with company match, and trust-based paid time off. Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements.

Fedcap Canada plays an integral role in Ontario's Employment Services Transformation as a Service System Manager (SSM). Working in partnership with Service Providers, employers, government agencies, and community organizations, Fedcap Canada strengthens local service delivery, expands access to employment opportunities, and supports individuals facing barriers to sustainable employment. **Position Summary**

Reporting to the President of Fedcap Inc./Fedcap Canada, the Senior Director provides strategic and operational oversight of Fedcap Canada's employment services operations. As the senior executive responsible for Service System Management across Ontario, this position ensures operational excellence, contractual performance, financial stewardship, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across multiple catchment areas.

The Senior Director leads the development and execution of strategies that strengthen Service Provider capacity, improve participant outcomes, and drive consistent, high-quality service delivery. Working closely with Ministry partners, Service Providers, employers, and community stakeholders, this position advances system-wide performance, strategic partnerships, and achievement of contractual Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

As a member of the senior leadership team, this role also supports organizational growth, business development, and expansion into new regions. * Serve as the senior operational executive for Fedcap Canada, exercising decision-making authority in partnership with the President of Fedcap Inc./Fedcap Canada.

* Identify emerging risks, opportunities, and strategic issues requiring executive attention or intervention.

**Service System Management & Operational Excellence**

* Provide executive oversight of employment services operations across all assigned catchment areas, ensuring consistency, quality, and alignment with contractual obligations and organizational standards.
* Lead the implementation and transition of new catchment areas, overseeing start-up activities, operational readiness, organizational capacity, and alignment with Fedcap's operating model.
* Strengthen Service Provider capacity through performance management, coaching, knowledge sharing, and implementation of consistent best practices.
* Advance localism and market stewardship to ensure services are responsive to regional labour markets, community needs, and underserved populations.
* Monitor Service Provider performance, identify systemic barriers, and implement strategic interventions to improve outcomes and operational effectiveness.
* Serve as a trusted executive advisor to Service Providers, promoting collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement while minimizing unnecessary administrative burden.
* Provide strategic direction for FedcapCARES, the organization's case management system, including identification of functionality needs, system enhancements, and operational priorities.
* Ensure service delivery practices, communications, and operations support Ontario's English and French language requirements.

**Contract Performance & Financial Stewardship**

* Maintain executive accountability for contractual performance, policy implementation, operational governance, financial management, and organizational sustainability.
* Oversee system-wide performance against contractual KPIs, including participant volumes, employment outcomes, retention measures, and inclusion targets.
* Ensure achievement of at least 85% of contractually established participant volumes through ongoing monthly performance monitoring and corrective action.

* Ensure Service Providers achieve contractual inclusion targets through equitable access, targeted engagement, and effective service delivery.

* Maintain expert knowledge of Ontario Employment Services Transformation, social assistance programs, workforce development policy, and evolving government priorities.
* Support business development opportunities, geographic expansion, and new service delivery models, ensuring operational scalability and organizational readiness.
* Promote effective cross-functional collaboration and strategic communication across Fedcap Canada and the broader Fedcap organization.

* Minimum seven years of progressively responsible leadership experience, including management of large-scale operations, complex service delivery systems, or Service Provider networks.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex government-funded programs, contracts, budgets, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience overseeing performance-driven service delivery operations with accountability for contractual outcomes and financial performance.
* Experience developing, coaching, and leading geographically dispersed or remote teams.
* Experience working with government agencies, public policy, and workforce development systems strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of Ontario Employment Services Transformation and Service System Management preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong executive leadership, strategic planning, organizational management, and decision-making capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to translate organizational strategy into measurable operational and financial results.
* Strong understanding of contract management, performance accountability, government reporting, and financial stewardship.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage government officials, senior executives, and community stakeholders.

* Strong analytical skills with experience using data, technology platforms, and performance management tools to guide operational decisions.

🚀 About Noon: Radically Changing the Way People Learn!
  
  
At
**Noon Academy**

**$41 million in Series B funding**

We’re laser-focused on reinventing schools in Saudi Arabia. We’re accelerating rapidly, well-funded, and profitable. We are on a mission to transform the physical classroom experience by introducing our highly engaging social, group-based learning and AI to make learning fun and improve learning efficacy. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer-to-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.
  
  
Hear it directly from our CEO and co-founder:
**this**
**Learn more about us:**
**here**
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Head of Teaching Excellence & Operations**
to own the full teacher lifecycle across
**Masarat**
and
**Ufuq**
—from workforce planning and hiring to development, deployment, performance management, and career progression.
  
  
You will build the systems, processes, and leadership practices needed to scale a high-performing teaching workforce while protecting instructional quality. This role combines educational judgement with operational discipline: ensuring the right teachers are in the right classrooms, supported to improve, and able to contribute beyond their teaching load.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Workforce Planning & Hiring:

+ Build and maintain a teacher demand model by subject, grade, and site, translating delivery requirements into hiring and capacity plans.
+ Own the end-to-end recruitment pipeline, including sourcing, screening, teaching demonstrations, selection, and readiness for deployment.
+ Establish consistent selection rubrics that assess subject expertise, instructional practice, and suitability for the delivery model.
+ Monitor time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, and hiring quality to identify bottlenecks and maintain reliable staffing coverage.

* Teacher Development & Career Progression:

+ Design and run structured onboarding that prepares teachers for effective classroom delivery.
+ Build continuing professional development (CPD) linked to observed teaching practice and evidence of student learning.
+ Establish a tiered career pathway with clear expectations, progression criteria, and development opportunities.
+ Equip teacher leaders and managers to deliver effective coaching and follow through on development plans.

* Deployment & Scheduling:

+ Own teacher assignment and scheduling across Masarat and Ufuq, aligning subject expertise and readiness with classroom needs.
+ Balance teaching load, development time, and wider contributions without compromising instructional quality.
+ Maintain visibility of workforce capacity, utilisation, and coverage risks, with contingency plans for staffing gaps.
+ Coordinate with academic and delivery teams to resolve scheduling conflicts and support continuity of teaching.

* Performance Governance:

+ Establish a consistent observation cadence across all classrooms, supported by clear quality standards and calibrated judgements.
+ Combine observation evidence with student feedback, learning outcomes, and platform data to identify strengths and improvement priorities.
+ Run timely feedback loops and structured improvement plans with clear expectations, support, and review points.
+ Own intervention and exit protocols, addressing sustained underperformance fairly and consistently in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
+ Identify, recognise, and retain high-performing teachers.

* Capability Activation:

+ Create structured routes for teachers to contribute beyond classroom delivery, including content development, assessment item writing, peer coaching, and quality review.
+ Match opportunities to demonstrated expertise, interests, and organisational needs.
+ Define clear time allocations, deliverables, quality expectations, and recognition for these contributions.
+ Track participation, output quality, and impact so capability activation is measurable and sustainable.

**About You**
**Requirements & Experience:**

* Scale & Experience: 10–15 years of experience in education, including at least 5 years leading a teaching workforce at scale (managing 100+ educators, directly or through managers).
* Lifecycle Ownership: Demonstrated ownership of the full teacher lifecycle: hiring, development, deployment, and performance management together.
* Instructional Background: A classroom teaching background and strong credibility in evaluating instructional practice.
* Market Expertise: Proven experience in the Saudi education market.
* Language Skills: Fluency in both Arabic and English (written and verbal).
* Education: A bachelor’s degree in education or a related field; a master’s degree is preferred.

**Core Competencies:**

* Workforce Planning: Translate demand into practical hiring, capacity, and deployment decisions.
* Instructional Quality Judgement: Distinguish strong teaching from weak practice and calibrate standards across teams.
* Teacher Development Design: Turn observed needs into targeted onboarding, coaching, and CPD.
* Operational Systems Thinking: Build repeatable processes that connect the full teacher lifecycle.
* Data Fluency: Use workforce, classroom, student, and platform evidence to guide decisions.
* Performance Leadership: Handle difficult conversations with clarity, fairness, and timely follow-through.
* Cross-Functional Coordination & Scale: Align academic, delivery, and people stakeholders around shared priorities while building systems that remain effective as the workforce grows.

What Success Looks Like in Year One
  
  

* Predictable Hiring: Time-to-fill and pipeline conversion are tracked, bottlenecks are addressed, and staffing plans consistently meet delivery needs.
* Consistent Quality Oversight: An observation cadence is actively running across all classrooms, with calibrated standards and documented feedback.
* Retention of Top Talent: Retention of high-performing teachers improves, supported by development and visible career opportunities.
* Proactive Performance Management: Interventions happen promptly, improvement plans are followed through, and exit decisions are handled consistently when required.
* Activated Teacher Capabilities: Routes for contributions beyond teaching are live, with defined time allocation, recognition, and measurable outputs and impact.

Why Work at Noon?
  
  

* Student First: Help build the first "Open Social Learning Platform" impacting millions of students across Saudi Arabia and the globe.
* Be Original & Own It: A working environment where you can challenge the status quo, take complete ownership, and build systems from the ground up.
* Never Deprive a Learner: We offer the freedom to innovate, experiment, and learn from "first-time mistakes."
* Be Better Everyday: Work closely with a dynamic leadership team committed to building the future of education in KSA.

Noon Academy is the #1 EdTech in MENAP, on a mission to radically change the way students learn. Founded in Riyadh in 2013, we've taught over 20 million students across five countries — and today we run Noon Tracks, hybrid micro-schools where a master teacher goes live across up to 20 classrooms at once, amplified by AI and peer-to-peer learning. Never study alone.

Title: Head of Enterprise Architecture
Description:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm and every member feels valued.

The Head of Enterprise Architecture (HEA) is responsible for establishing and leading Medica's enterprise architecture organization and ensuring Medica’s enterprise architecture aligns and enables, our business strategy, operating capabilities, technology, data, and processes, resulting in measurable and increasing enterprise value. Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the HEA serves as a strategic advisor to the CIO and senior business and technology leaders and leads a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines. The HEA also leads an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice to align architects and architecture-adjacent roles around common principles, standards, methods, patterns, and decision practices.

Business Architecture is a foundational discipline of the practice. The HEA ensures a clear understanding of enterprise business objectives, the current and required state of business capabilities, and the value-aligned roadmaps needed to move from current to target state. These roadmaps integrate changes across technology, data, processes, organization, skills, and operating models. The role partners closely with the Office of the CIO, Enterprise Transformation, Business Process Re-engineering, Product Ownership, Engineering, Data, Security, and business leadership to translate strategy into executable change.

The HEA will evolve Enterprise Architecture from a traditional, centralized governance model toward an enabling, embedded, and delivery-oriented practice. Architecture will engage earlier and more deeply in strategic and day-to-day delivery, using reusable standards, reference architectures, patterns, guardrails, and risk-based decision frameworks to accelerate sound decisions. The HEA will also advance AI-enabled architecture practices to automate routine documentation, analysis, standards validation, knowledge management, and governance activities so architects can focus on solving critical business problems, transformation, complex design decisions, and delivery enablement.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Structure and Advance Enterprise Architecture Practices**

* Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise architecture strategy, operating model, principles, standards, methods, and practices.
* Establish Business Architecture as the connective layer between enterprise strategy, transformation, product portfolios, business processes, organizational design, data, and technology.
* Ensure development and maintenance of enterprise business capability models; partner to assess current-state maturity and identify capability gaps, dependencies, duplication, and investment needs.
* Translate enterprise strategy and business objectives into target states, transition states, and value-aligned capability roadmaps integrating changes to people, process, technology, data, organization, skills, and operating models.
* Provide enterprise leaders with clear views of strategic dependencies, tradeoffs, sequencing, technical health, and investment implications.
* Ensure technology strategy is traceable to business strategy and capability requirements.

**Deliver Enterprise Transformation & Strategy through Architecture**

* Serve as a strategic architecture advisor to the CIO, executive leadership, Transformation, Product, and business leaders.
* Partner with Enterprise Transformation and Business Process Re-engineering to connect strategic objectives, transformation portfolios, and process redesign to required business-capability changes.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Management to connect enterprise capability roadmaps with product strategies, investment priorities, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure architecture strategy reflects the operating, regulatory, data, and interoperability requirements of a healthcare organization, with particular emphasis on the health plan/payer environment.
* Provide architectural leadership for healthcare interoperability and industry standards, including X12 EDI, HL7 FHIR, USCDI, and other applicable healthcare information-exchange standards.
* Translate regulatory and interoperability requirements into enterprise capabilities and strategic roadmaps in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Security, Privacy, Product, Data, and business leaders.

**Architecture Enablement & Governance**

* Modernize the Architecture Review process from a primarily centralized approval mechanism into a risk-based architecture enablement model embedded earlier in strategy, discovery, design, and delivery.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, guardrails, decision frameworks, and architecture decision records that increase delivery autonomy while maintaining enterprise alignment.
* Define clear decision rights across Enterprise Architecture, domain architecture, solution architecture, Engineering, Product, Security, Data, and related functions.
* Partner with engineering and technology leaders to evaluate and select strategic platforms, core technologies, architectural patterns, and engineering approaches.
* Guide modernization of core capabilities including Cloud, APIs, integration, data platforms, automation, AI, SaaS, and digital capabilities while reducing unnecessary complexity, duplication, and technical debt.
* Use AI and automation to improve architecture knowledge discovery, documentation, standards validation, impact analysis, dependency identification, and governance workflows, freeing architects for higher-value work.
* Measure architecture effectiveness through business outcomes, delivery enablement, reuse, simplification, risk reduction, technology health, and decision quality.

**Architecture Team Leadership**

* Lead, develop, and mentor a multidisciplinary architecture organization spanning enterprise, business, security, data, integration, and related architecture disciplines.
* Establish and lead an enterprise-wide Architecture Community of Practice encompassing architects and architecture-adjacent roles across centralized and distributed teams.
* Define common architecture principles, terminology, methods, artifacts, modeling approaches, standards, and expectations across the organization.
* Create mechanisms for knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, emerging practices, and lessons learned across the architecture community.
* Develop architecture talent, competency models, career paths, succession plans, and leadership capability across the enterprise.
* Build an architecture culture based on influence, transparency, collaboration, practical guidance, and accountability rather than centralized control.
* Operate effectively from executive strategy through delivery-level architecture, communicating complex business and technology concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 15+ years of progressively responsible experience across enterprise technology, architecture, business transformation, engineering, or related disciplines; significant leadership experience building and leading enterprise or domain architecture functions in complex organizations.
* 5+ years of people management experience leading highly technical roles in direct, indirect, and contractor roles.
* Business capability modeling and capability-based planning; strategy-to-execution alignment; value-stream and operating-model analysis; enterprise transformation and roadmap development; architecture governance and operating models; modern cloud, API, integration, data, security, SaaS, automation, and AI architectures; healthcare interoperability; executive communication, facilitation, organizational change, stakeholder influence, and talent development

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience managing vendor relationships.
* Healthcare payer / managed care experience strongly preferred; broader healthcare experience considered.
