AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Role:** Manager, Software Development
  
**Location:** Richmond Hill, ON (Office-based)
  
  
The Manager, Software Development leads the newly formed engineering team delivering the Image& Fax Aviator Platform. This first-line manager will recruit, onboard, coach, and directly manage software engineers and technical specialists working across Java-based cloud services, Python-based AI and document intelligence, React user experiences, enterprise integrations, and platform operations. The role is accountable for day-to-day people leadership, Scrum execution, engineering delivery, quality, and operational readiness. The manager partners with Product Management and the Principal Engineer to translate strategy into executable plans while establishing an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing engineering culture.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
Engineering Delivery
  
  

* Own day-to-day execution across one or more Scrum teams and translate roadmap priorities into credible sprint and release plans.
* Partner with Product Management to balance customer value, platform foundations, security, reliability, technical debt, and innovation.
* Manage team capacity, dependencies, risks, milestones, and commitments while maintaining clear ownership.
* Ensure increments include code, automated tests, security controls, documentation, observability, deployment automation, and support readiness.
* Provide concise status, risk, staffing, and decision information to senior leadership.
* Escalate material risks early and drive corrective action when scope, staffing, architecture, or dependencies threaten commitments.

People Leadership and Team Building
  
  

* Recruit and onboard the initial eight external hires by the approved target date, then help scale the team to approximately 16 engineers.
* Directly manage engineers and technical specialists, with effective delegation through senior engineers and technical leads.
* Set clear performance expectations and provide frequent coaching, feedback, recognition, and career-development guidance.
* Build an inclusive culture that values customer outcomes, transparency, ownership, collaboration, and technical excellence.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR on requisitions, interview plans, candidate assessment, selection, offers, and onboarding.
* Address performance, engagement, retention, and team-health issues promptly and professionally.

Technical and Operational Leadership
  
  

* Work with the Principal Engineer to establish standards for Java 17+, Spring Boot, Python, React/TypeScript, event-driven services, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and cloud platforms.
* Maintain enough technical depth to assess tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, support hiring decisions, and remove engineering blockers.
* Drive secure-by-design practices for identity, authorization, tenant isolation, privacy, auditability, APIs, encryption, secrets, and software supply-chain controls.
* Promote automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, OpenTelemetry, service-level objectives, and production monitoring.
* Ensure architecture and delivery decisions support resilience, scalability, recoverability, cost management, and integration with existing products.
* Lead incident follow-up, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions in a blameless, learning-oriented manner.

Agile and Scrum Leadership
  
  

* Establish consistent Scrum practices including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Coach engineers and Product Owners on well-formed user stories, acceptance criteria, estimation, Definition of Ready, and Definition of Done.
* Use delivery metrics to improve predictability and flow, not to rank individuals or encourage unhealthy utilization targets.
* Ensure blockers and dependencies are identified early and sprint commitments remain realistic.
* Turn retrospective findings into measurable improvements while avoiding unnecessary ceremony.
* Promote visible work status, shared accountability, and frequent demonstration of working software.

What You Need to Succeed
  
  

* 8+ years of progressively responsible software engineering experience, including 5+ years of direct engineering people leadership.
* Experience directly managing software engineers and technical specialists in a SaaS, cloud-platform, or enterprise-software organization.
* Proven success recruiting and onboarding external engineering talent and building a new or rapidly growing team.
* Demonstrated delivery ownership in Agile/Scrum environments with interdependent product workstreams.
* Strong understanding of cloud-native microservices, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architecture, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and secure development.
* Working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot sufficient to assess candidates, understand design tradeoffs, and guide execution.
* Experience partnering with Product Management on roadmaps, backlogs, release plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Experience coaching employees, managing performance, and handling difficult delivery or organizational situations.
* Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, peers, candidates, and executives.
* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Title: AIR FREIGHT PRICING AND OPERATIONS MANAGER
Description:
Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager

**Company:** Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC  
**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Department:** Air Freight Operations & Pricing  
**Position Level:** Senior Management  
**Reports To:** Directors & Management

Job Overview

Unique Courier Cargo Services LLC is seeking a **highly experienced, commercially driven, and result-oriented Air Freight Operations & Pricing Manager** to take complete ownership of the company's air freight operations, pricing, airline relationships, and business development opportunities.

We are looking for a strong leader with extensive knowledge of international air freight, transshipment operations, airline pricing, and CMC (Cargo Mega Terminal) facilities and their potential business opportunities.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently managing the entire operations and pricing team, maintaining strong airline relationships, maximizing enquiry conversions, ensuring operational excellence, and taking full accountability for departmental performance.

**This is an ownership-driven leadership position, not merely an operational supervisory role.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Complete Operations Management & Accountability**

* Take full responsibility for the day-to-day performance of the Air Freight Operations and Pricing Department.
* Lead, supervise, train, and guide the entire operations and pricing team.
* Ensure every customer enquiry is properly reviewed, priced, followed up, and converted wherever commercially feasible.
* Take complete accountability for all enquiries, quotations, bookings, shipment execution, and operational escalations.
* Establish clear responsibilities, productivity standards, and performance expectations for each team member.
* Ensure timely shipment execution, accurate documentation, regulatory compliance, and effective coordination with all stakeholders.
* Independently resolve operational challenges and implement preventive measures.

**2. Airline Relationships & Pricing Management**

* Maintain excellent working relationships with major airlines, GSAs, cargo terminals, and handling agents.
* Negotiate competitive freight rates, special rates, allotments, and commercial arrangements.
* Possess strong knowledge of airline networks, routing options, capacity availability, and international cargo regulations.
* Develop effective pricing strategies to improve both conversion rates and gross profitability.
* Build direct relationships with airline decision-makers to secure commercially advantageous opportunities.
* Continuously monitor market rates, competitor pricing, and airline developments.

**3. Transshipment & CMC Business Development**

* Demonstrate extensive knowledge of international cargo transshipment operations through Dubai and other major hubs.
* Identify and develop business opportunities involving CMC facilities, cargo consolidation, transit cargo, and cross-border freight movements.
* Develop commercially viable solutions for cargo movements through Dubai, including documentation, handling, routing, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish relationships with international freight forwarding agents and overseas business partners.
* Identify new trade lanes, airline partnerships, and transshipment business opportunities.
* Present practical business development proposals to management, including revenue potential, expected margins, operational requirements, and implementation plans.

**4. Enquiry Management & 95% Conversion Target**

* Drive the department toward a **target of 95% conversion of qualified, commercially viable enquiries**.
* Ensure 100% of enquiries are recorded, assigned, monitored, and followed up.
* Implement a structured quotation and follow-up system to minimize lost business.
* Analyze unsuccessful quotations and identify the reasons for lost business.
* Ensure quotations are competitive, accurate, profitable, and delivered within established turnaround times.
* Work closely with the Sales Department to convert enquiries into confirmed shipments.
* Take ownership of improving enquiry quality, quotation efficiency, customer retention, and shipment volumes.

**5. Weekly Management Reporting**

Submit a detailed weekly performance report to management covering:

* Total enquiries received, quotations submitted, and shipments confirmed.
* Enquiry conversion percentage and comparison against the 95% target.
* Total sales revenue and gross profit generated.
* Shipment volumes, chargeable weight, and major trade lanes.
* Lost enquiries, reasons for non-conversion, and corrective actions.
* Airline rate developments and negotiated commercial benefits.
* Individual team performance, productivity, and accountability.
* Operational issues, shipment delays, and resolutions.
* New business opportunities, particularly in transshipment and CMC operations.
* Action plan for the coming week with measurable targets.

The Manager must be able to **explain departmental performance, identify shortcomings, and present actionable solutions rather than merely report figures.**

**6. Leadership & Professional Representation**

* Represent the company professionally in meetings with airlines, customers, international agents, and business partners.
* Maintain excellent personal presentation, professional grooming, communication, and business etiquette.
* Demonstrate confidence, strong negotiation capabilities, commercial awareness, and sound decision-making.
* Conduct regular departmental performance meetings and ensure effective team coordination.
* Develop employees through training, mentoring, and practical operational guidance.
* Demonstrate leadership through ownership, discipline, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Act as the primary escalation point for air freight operational and pricing matters.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **8–10 years of relevant experience** in air freight forwarding, operations, and pricing, preferably within the UAE market.
* At least 3–5 years in a managerial or senior leadership position.
* Established professional relationships with airlines, GSAs, and air cargo handling agents in the UAE.
* Strong expertise in transshipment operations, Dubai air cargo facilities, CMC-related opportunities, and cargo handling procedures.
* Excellent knowledge of import, export, transit cargo, customs procedures, AWB documentation, and airline regulations.
* Working knowledge of IATA regulations, dangerous goods procedures, and international freight forwarding practices.
* Proven ability to negotiate competitive airline rates and develop profitable freight solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing operational teams and improving enquiry conversion rates.
* Strong analytical, reporting, communication, and commercial negotiation skills.
* Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
* Professional appearance, leadership presence, and ability to represent the company at senior-level meetings.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and deliver measurable results with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will be expected to operate with the mindset of a **Department Head and Business Leader**, taking responsibility not only for completing shipments but also for building a highly efficient, profitable, and commercially competitive Air Freight Department.

Management expects someone who can independently identify problems, provide solutions, generate opportunities, develop the team, and deliver measurable improvements in operational performance and profitability.

**We are looking for a strong, decisive, hands-on leader who takes complete ownership of the department, builds lasting airline relationships, drives business growth, and is accountable for results.**

The InfoSec team protects Affirm's systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. Title: Senior Director - Identity and Access Management Operations
Description:
Requisition ID: 279348
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.
  
  
The Senior Director of Identity and Access Management Operations leads a global team responsible for delivering the Bank’s internal identity management operations securely, reliably and effectively.
  
  
**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

* Lead and oversee the Identity and Access Management Operations (IAMO) function within the Enterprise Security Identity Access Management department.
* Oversee the secure and timely delivery of day-to-day operational requests in accordance with established service levels, controls, and operational standards.
* Provide oversight and accountability for the consistent execution of IAM operational controls, including access provisioning, privileged access, identity lifecycle management, sensitive staffing changes, and other key control activities
* Own operational performance including incident, problem, change and capacity management within IAMO, with accountability for timely resolution of production issues.
* Use AI and Agentic capabilities to drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement, identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve service quality, and address recurring incidents and operational risk.
* Lead and develop the global IAM Operations organization, establishing clear accountability, effective workforce and capacity management, succession planning, and strong partnerships with IAM Engineering, Product, Technology Operations, Cybersecurity and business stakeholders.
* Ensure there are ongoing communication and reporting of service metrics and initiative status to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the broader IAM and Enterprise Security strategy and roadmap.
* Ensure reviews with the 2nd and 3rd lines of defence are completed successfully, with requests answered and commitments met on time.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture should be considered in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment, communicating vison/values/business strategy and managing succession and development planning for the team.
* Direct day-to-day activities in a manner consistent with the Bank’s risk culture and the relevant risk appetite statement and limits. Communicates the Bank’s risk culture and risk appetite statement throughout their teams.
* Create an environment in which their team pursues effective and efficient operations of their respective areas in accordance with Scotiabank’s Values, its Code of Conduct and the Global Sales Principles, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational, compliance, AML/ATF/sanctions and conduct risk.
* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviours; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and managing succession and development planning for the team.

**Skills**
**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

* Working knowledge of information security and be able to effectively collaborate with key stakeholders globally to enable the delivery of projects that protect the Bank.
* Bachelors or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or other related field, OR equivalent work experience.
* Security certification(s) (CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CRISC etc.) would be an asset(s).
* Knowledge and understanding of Identity and Access Management specific laws, rules, regulations, and Guidelines such as SOX, OCC, NIST, ISO/EC, FFIEC within the financial services sector

**What's in it for you?**

* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employee to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.
* Upskilling through online courses, cross-functional development opportunities, and tuition assistance.
* Competitive Rewards program including bonus, flexible vacation, personal, sick days and benefits will start on day one.
* Community Engagement - no matter where you choose to work from; we offer opportunities for community engagement & belonging with our various programs such as hackathons, contests, Humans of Digital and much more.

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto
  
  
Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.
  
  
At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Title: Directeur principal ou directrice principal, Technologies, Stratégie et opérations
Description:
**Aperçu**
Chez KPMG au Canada, les employés sont appelés à mettre à profit leurs perspectives pour relever les plus grands défis du Canada. Ici, vous pouvez créer un élan qui dépasse notre organisation, développer des compétences de demain et prendre votre carrière en main, et ce, avec du soutien à chaque étape. Joignez-vous à un cabinet où votre carrière peut vraiment faire une différence.
  
  
La personne titulaire du poste de directeur ou directrice principal·e, Technologies, Stratégie et opérations collabore étroitement avec le directeur général, Architecture technologique et le directeur de la Technologie du STI. Elle traduit la stratégie, les priorités et les feuilles de route en activités coordonnées à l’échelle de l’équipe. Elle assure la coordination centrale de l’architecture technologique et veille à ce que les activités liées à l’architecture, à la mise en œuvre et aux opérations soient harmonisées et bien coordonnées et progressent efficacement. De plus, elle structure les priorités de la fonction, en assure la visibilité et en suit l’avancement, tout en respectant les responsabilités établies à l’égard de la stratégie technologique, des décisions relatives à l’architecture et de la gouvernance officielle des projets et des programmes.
  
  
**Ce que vous ferez**

* Soutenir la direction de l’architecture technologique dans la mise en œuvre des stratégies, des priorités et des feuilles de route établies en les traduisant en activités et jalons, et en définissant clairement les dépendances et les responsabilités à l’échelle de la fonction
* Maintenir une vue d’ensemble des priorités et des activités de l’architecture technologique pour soutenir la planification et la prise de décisions de la direction
* Appuyer l’analyse, la planification et la coordination des priorités émergentes et des initiatives spéciales en reliant les plans d’architecture technologique aux priorités globales du STI et du cabinet
* Servir de point de coordination central entre les activités liées à l’architecture, au développement, à la mise en œuvre et aux opérations, y compris pour ce qui touche les dépendances, le séquencement des tâches, les décisions et les transferts entre les architectes, les responsables techniques et les équipes de mise en œuvre
* Veiller à ce que les décisions et les priorités en matière d’architecture soient prises en compte dans la planification et l’exécution de la mise en œuvre
* Participer à la coordination des activités d’architecture technologique entre les différentes fonctions, ainsi qu’à l’échelle du cabinet canadien et de l’organisation mondiale
* Établir des modes de fonctionnement efficaces qui aident l’équipe à gérer les priorités, les décisions, les risques, les mesures à prendre et les dépendances, et à assurer le suivi des mesures et des engagements convenus
* Repérer les occasions de simplifier les processus, d’améliorer les méthodes de travail et de renforcer la coordination au sein de l’équipe
* Fournir à la direction une vision intégrée des besoins, des activités et des dépendances pour appuyer une planification efficace des ressources et des priorités
* Appuyer la coordination et la réalisation des initiatives d’architecture technologique en établissant clairement les résultats, les jalons, les responsables, les dépendances et les risques, en particulier lorsque le travail nécessite la collaboration des équipes d’architecture et de mise en œuvre
* Travailler de concert avec le bureau de gestion de projets et les gestionnaires de projet désignés pour les initiatives nécessitant une gouvernance officielle, et porter à l’attention de la direction les risques, les contraintes et les décisions exigeant son intervention
* Fournir à la direction de l’architecture technologique des mises à jour concises axées sur la prise de décisions concernant les priorités, les progrès, les risques et les enjeux
* Assurer la coordination avec les autres équipes du STI au pays et ailleurs dans le monde, les directeurs de la Technologie des différentes fonctions et les parties prenantes concernées pour atteindre les objectifs en matière d’architecture technologique
* Préparer et animer des séances de planification d’équipe, des revues de direction, des séances de travail et d’autres rencontres de coordination; communiquer clairement les questions techniques et les enjeux liés à la réalisation des initiatives aux parties prenantes techniques et non techniques

**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**

* Baccalauréat en informatique, en génie, en systèmes d’information, en gestion des technologies, en affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente)
* Expérience considérable dans des environnements technologiques, idéalement dans les domaines de la prestation de services technologiques, de l’optimisation de l’architecture, des opérations technologiques ou des domaines connexes
* Compréhension approfondie des environnements technologiques d’entreprise et de la relation entre l’architecture, la mise en œuvre et les activités courantes, ainsi que des connaissances techniques suffisantes pour comprendre les concepts d’architecture, les dépendances, les considérations relatives à la mise en œuvre et les risques liés à la prestation, sans nécessairement être spécialiste technique
* Solides compétences en stratégie et en opérations, notamment en matière de planification, de priorisation, de coordination, d’analyse et de présentation de l’information aux dirigeants.
* Expérience de la coordination d’initiatives technologiques complexes faisant intervenir plusieurs équipes, parties prenantes et dépendances
* Grand sens de l’organisation, excellent jugement et fortes aptitudes en communication; capacité à structurer, à clarifier et à faire progresser des travaux complexes ou ambigus, et à travailler efficacement avec des leaders en technologie, des architectes, des spécialistes techniques et des professionnels de la gestion de projet

Ce poste requiert une maîtrise écrite et orale de l’anglais. La personne retenue sera appelée à soutenir des collègues ou des parties prenantes anglophones de partout au Canada, et à collaborer avec eux.

Title: Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.

This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.

If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.

‎

IMCO’s actively managed Global Credit strategy (~$10.1B AUM) delivers higher risk-adjusted returns through a unified approach to credit investing, integrating public and private credit within a single, globally diversified portfolio. The strategy adopts a holistic approach to portfolio construction, allocating across public credit segments, including investment grade, high yield, leveraged loans, and structured credit, alongside private credit segments to capture relative value opportunities, enhance diversification, and optimize liquidity and return outcomes across market cycles.

Our collaborative culture and value-add approach to strategic partnerships makes us a preferred partner to some of the largest investors in the world. We have a targeted strategy to grow our highly diversified Global Credit portfolio and are looking for a highly motivated Associate Portfolio Manager to join our Global Credit team with a focus on public credit!

The Associate Portfolio Manager, Public Credit will play a key role in managing IMCO’s externally managed Public Credit portfolio, with responsibilities spanning manager selection and due diligence, portfolio strategy and construction, and ongoing monitoring and oversight. The role combines rigorous investment analysis with active portfolio management, while also contributing to ongoing initiatives to enhance the Global Credit platform and target operating model, including the implementation of investment systems and processes and the development of advanced analytics and AI capabilities to improve portfolio insights and support investment decision-making.

**As a Member of Our Global Credit Team, You Will Contribute Across Three Core Areas: Manager Selection & Oversight, Portfolio Management and Strategy, and Platform Enhancement:**

* Provide analytical and portfolio management support to the Managing Director in overseeing externally managed public credit portfolios on a day-to-day basis, including ad hoc analysis and strategic initiatives.
* Source, screen, and conduct due diligence on external public credit managers across strategies (e.g., investment grade, high yield, loans and structured credit), utilizing data platforms and AI-enabled tools to analyze performance, identify risks, and support manager screening and ongoing evaluation.
* Lead and support the preparation of investment recommendations, including drafting investment memos and presentations for internal Investment Committee approval.
* Assist in structuring and negotiating investment mandates, guidelines, and negotiating fee arrangements with external managers in collaboration with risk, legal and other internal teams.
* Conduct ongoing monitoring of external managers, including performance attribution, risk exposures, style drift, and adherence to investment guidelines; leverage AI to enhance efficiency in analysis, identify performance and risk trends, and support the development of portfolio-level reporting and insights for senior management.
* Lead or contribute to initiatives within Global Credit to enhance portfolio management infrastructure through the application of AI and the integration of new investment systems and analytics capabilities; partner with internal teams (Risk, Performance, Operations, Technology) to improve investment data quality to enable more effective analysis, reporting, and decision-making.
* Support portfolio construction and strategic asset allocation across public credit, including contributing to capital allocation decisions across segments and managers, and shaping overall portfolio strategy.
* Maintain a strong understanding of global public credit markets, including macroeconomic trends, interest rates, credit spreads, and technical factors, to inform manager selection and portfolio positioning.
* Engage regularly with external managers through diligence meetings, portfolio reviews, and on-site visits to assess portfolio strategy, market outlook, and execution capabilities.
* Support client and stakeholder reporting, including preparation of quarterly updates, market commentary, and materials for senior management and board-level discussions.

**What do you need to succeed?**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in asset management, with a focus on public credit investing and manager selection and oversight.
* Experience leveraging data analytics and AI-enabled tools to support investment research, manager evaluation, or portfolio insights.
* Strong understanding of global public credit markets, including corporate bonds, leveraged loans, structured credit, and credit market dynamics.
* Experience conducting due diligence on external investment managers, including evaluation of investment processes, portfolio construction, and risk management.
* Experience in private debt / private credit or broader private markets is considered an asset.
* Undergraduate degree required. CFA designation, MBA or master’s degree(s) are considered an asset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex investment information into clear, actionable insights.
* Effective communicator with the ability to present investment recommendations and market views to senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative team player with an appreciation for diverse perspectives and a high-performing team environment.
* Self-starter who can engage and motivate other people around key ideas, effectively listen and provide constructive feedback to others, participate in discussion and brainstorming.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain relationships with internal teams and external managers.

‎

The base salary range for this position is CAD $140,000.00 - $180,750.00. The placement within the range is determined by the range of market pay for the specific position, as well as the candidate's knowledge, skillset and experience relative to the requirements of the position and to internal peers. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible to participate in IMCO's annual incentive plan. As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you with the specific details for this position, as well as the total rewards offering at IMCO including our comprehensive benefits package and defined benefit pension plan.

‎

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Our hybrid work model prioritizes an office-first approach, encouraging employees to make the most of our collaborative workspace at 16 York Street, Suite 2400, Toronto, ON M5J 0E6. This welcoming environment fosters teamwork, connection, and professional growth. While flexibility remains a key component of our model, we believe that regular in-office engagement enhances productivity and strengthens our culture. Our approach supports a fulfilling lifestyle that balances professional ambition with personal wellbeing.

Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support parts of our recruitment process, such as screening and assessments. However, all hiring decisions are made by our recruitment team. Candidates being considered for this position will be required to undergo background screening.*

Title: Senior Manager - Fund Client Services and Support Lead
Description:
Neuberger is seeking a Senior Manager to lead Funds Client Services & Support, the team that stands behind our funds for the broker-dealers, wirehouses, RIAs, and retirement platforms that distribute them, and for direct retail accounts.
  
  
You will lead the Retail desk, which includes our call center, and the Intermediary desk. You will also govern the external transfer agent and NSCC processing that support our 40 Act funds, and you will provide a white-glove experience to our key distribution partners. As Transfer Agency lead on new fund launches and ETF conversions, you will help shape the fund lifecycle.
  
  
This role suits a hands-on, relationship-driven leader with deep mutual fund operations and transfer agency experience, sound judgment under pressure, and a practical interest in using automation and AI to work more efficiently.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Lead Client and Intermediary Servicing
  
  

* Lead the Retail and Intermediary desks, including the call center, investor inquiries, and statements.
* Oversee daily trading across omnibus and direct accounts, including share class exchanges and clearing of fund activity with intermediaries.
* Deliver a white-glove service model for our largest broker-dealer and distribution platform relationships, with a service approach suited to retirement platforms.
* Guide clients through account transfers, required minimum distributions, exchanges, and share class eligibility.
* Draft and coordinate client communications, and contribute to Board reporting.
* Support the US Intermediary Sales team in distributing our offshore funds.

Govern the Transfer Agent and Operational Controls
  
  

* Oversee the external transfer agent and NSCC activity, monitoring performance against key performance indicators and service levels, investigating issues, and escalating risks.
* Conduct on-site and virtual operational health checks, and manage operational risk assessments of third-party vendors.
* Ensure adherence to each fund's prospectus and Statement of Additional Information (SAI).
* Monitor large cash flows that may affect investor concentration.
* Support operations for closed-end funds.
* Manage industry reporting obligations, including ICI surveys.

Shape the Fund Lifecycle
  
  

* Partner with Product Management on changes to existing funds, including ETF conversions, and serve as Transfer Agency lead on new fund launches.
* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Reporting, Marketing, RFP, and Portfolio Management to meet deadlines and deliver a consistent client experience.

Lead People and Drive Improvement
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of client service professionals.
* Act as a day-to-day coordination point across teams, using data insights and AI-enabled automation to improve processes, reduce manual effort, and shorten turnaround times.

**Required**
**What You Bring**
Education, Licenses and Registrations
  
  

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
* Required at hire: Series 7 and Series 24 (the role supervises trading and client-facing activity).
* Required within 6 months of hire, if not already held: Series 66, or both Series 63 and Series 65.

Experience and Industry Knowledge
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in mutual fund operations or client servicing, including managing teams and supporting 40 Act funds.
* Hands-on transfer agency experience, including day-to-day servicing, shareholder processing, and investor record integrity.
* Working knowledge of broker-dealer operations and intermediary servicing, including omnibus and direct account structures, share class exchanges, and clearing of fund activity.
* Extensive knowledge of the NSCC Fund/Serv platform including the networking of accounts and the oversight of the Mutual Fund Profile.
* Familiarity with the requirements of fund prospectuses and Statements of Additional Information, and with retirement account servicing such as required minimum distributions and account transfers.

Vendor Oversight and Operational Risk
  
  

* Experience governing a third-party transfer agent or similar service provider. This includes setting and monitoring service levels, validating vendor reporting, investigating discrepancies, and escalating issues to resolution.
* Ability to assess operational risk and conduct vendor health checks, with sound judgment on when to escalate.
* Strong attention to detail and a control-minded approach, particularly when monitoring large cash flows and ensuring fund compliance.

Client Leadership
  
  

* A record of building trusted, long-term relationships with broker-dealers, wirehouses, RIAs, and retirement platforms, and of providing a high-touch service model.
* Skill in managing complex client escalations calmly, and in coordinating across Legal, Compliance, Operations, Reporting, Marketing, RFP, and Portfolio Management to resolve them.
* Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, including the ability to draft clear client communications and Board-level reporting.

People Leadership
  
  

* Experience leading, coaching, and developing client service teams, including managers of desks or functions.
* Ability to set clear expectations, build accountability, and sustain high performance in a service environment.

Analytical and Technology Skills
  
  

* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including working with large datasets, identifying trends, and presenting insights clearly to senior audiences.
* Ability to turn operational data into insights that support process improvement and business growth.

Description:

----------------

We are looking for a Mobile QA Manager to lead the team responsible for validating our iOS and Android applications. * Lead work across large matrix teams in engineering, QA, product, technology, and IoT. Align teams on dependencies, defect resolution, readiness, risks, and decisions, including when they do not report to you.

----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical engineering experience.
* At least 7 years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, software testing, or a closely related technical field, including substantial experience with mobile applications.
* At least 3 years of direct people management experience in an engineering or QA organization, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and capacity planning.
* Experience leading large matrix teams or complex work across engineering, QA, technology, or IoT teams outside your direct reporting line.
* Strong experience testing iOS and Android applications across devices and OS versions, including connectivity, permissions, notifications, app lifecycle, upgrades, and integrations.
* Experience evaluating risk-based test plans and managing functional, integration, exploratory, regression, and release testing.
* Working knowledge of mobile automation, CI pipelines, defect triage, test management, logs, and diagnostics.
* Ability to explain technical risks and execution constraints clearly to engineers, product partners, and senior leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience with mobile applications connected to embedded software, cameras, IoT devices, or cloud services.
* Experience with mobile performance, reliability, accessibility, security, telemetry, or analytics validation.
* Experience improving automation strategy, test infrastructure, quality metrics, staged rollouts, or beta programs.

**What Success Looks Like:**
----------------------------

You build a technically capable and engaged team that makes realistic testing commitments and delivers trustworthy results. Risks and constraints are visible early. Partners understand quality status and next steps. The team learns from defects and customer feedback and continually improves its coverage and execution.

Title: BMW Program Manager
Description:
**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Client Partnership & Programme Governance**

* Act as direct support to the BMW ME Training Manager in planning, executing and controlling the Training Centre, its activities and resources.
* Act as GP Strategies' primary point of contact and escalation for BMW on the training programme.
* Develop and maintain programme and project plans, including milestones, owners, deliverables, budget, implementation timing and approval gateways, with a plan for each new learning initiative.
* Lead the start-up phase of new projects, including problem definition, concept development and vendor selection.
* Identify training and coaching opportunities that support BMW ME's business objectives, using requirements obtained from the market or the BMW Regional Office (RO). Evaluate the training strategy against changing market and importer needs, and recommend new learning and development initiatives to BMW.
* Lead the development of training and coaching programmes, with Trainer input, for BMW approval.
* Set up meetings, supported by the Training Co-ordinator, with the people responsible for each new project and for approving the proposed solution.
* Ensure each new programme is delivered on time, within budget and to BMW standards, including reporting and participant feedback.
* Set up and own the training materials repository, together with the Training Co-ordinator, tracking all existing material under version control so that there is a clean, current record of every update, replacement and enhancement; ensure materials developed for new programmes are provided to BMW and retained in the repository.
* Using the repository as the starting point for material reviews and overhauls, revisit existing training programmes so that they reflect the current product range and BMW's updated training methods; table update plans with BMW where needed, and execute them once approved.
* Receive the Sales & Product Trainers' proposals for improving sales training materials and methodologies, and decide which to take forward as part of programme reviews and overhauls.
* Review and approve the annual training plan and training calendar prepared by the Training Co-ordinator before submission to BMW.
* Support the training needs analysis.
* Support quarterly adjustments to the training plan.
* Support the planning of Focus Training and coaching.
* Manage programme risks, issues and changes, and communicate their impact on scope, timelines, resources and cost.
* Maintain programme documentation, decisions and action logs.
* Maintain a formal improvement tracker of all proposals tabled with BMW, together with BMW's responses.
* Record and track all new projects delivered by or via GP, and all value-added services.
* Lead GP's participation in audits, programme reviews and BMW governance activities.

**Client Meetings & Reporting**

* Run the weekly operations meeting with the team, covering priorities, delivery status and actions.
* Chair the monthly client meeting with BMW, covering performance, KPIs, SLA results and the forward plan.
* Lead the quarterly account meeting with BMW, including review of annual volumetrics, capacity assumptions and demand trends.
* Review all reports and the monthly KPI scoreboard before they are sent to BMW.
* Own and sign off the monthly SLA report, and chair the monthly joint review of the SLA exception register with BMW.
* Keep BMW and the BMW RO informed of successes and noteworthy stories, and maintain a success log with evidence.

**Financial Control**

* Prepare annual budget inputs, including training volumes, trainer mix and costs, for the Senior Director, who sets rates and agrees the budget with BMW.
* Control all programme financials against the approved budget, including spend, variance and BMW over- or under-spend, and escalate commercial risks.
* Prepare the monthly forward forecast of revenue, vendor cost and training volumes.
* Control GP revenue recovery: sign off monthly BMW invoicing so that all billable activity is recovered, and reconcile SLA credit deductions.
* Reconcile vendor costs against BMW invoicing every month.
* Support the maintenance of the training tracker and the monthly billing data.
* Liaise with GP Finance and the Senior Director on billing, forecasting and commercial matters.

**Service Quality, KPIs & SLA Compliance**

* Set, monitor and control KPIs for the entire team; act on deviations and identify improvement opportunities.
* Define, maintain and monitor service delivery quality standards for the Training Centre, and lead continuous-improvement reviews.
* Receive and review the Training Administrator's reports on the Operating Standards Manual and the adoption of agreed processes across the team, and act on any gaps.
* Submit Deviation Requests to BMW by the 14-day fill-rate measurement date.
* Submit Legitimate Cause claims with supporting evidence within the contractual timelines.
* Direct the Training Administrator's support in preparing Deviation Requests and Legitimate Cause claims.
* Dispute SLA results with evidence within 5 business days of notification.
* Issue Service Rectification Plans and corrective and preventive action plans when Non-Compliance Events occur.
* Hold accountability for the compliance register of vendor agreements, work permits, licences and sub-supplier documents maintained by the Training Administrator.

**Product Launches, Conferences & Events**

* Own all product launches, conferences and events end to end, as decision-maker and custodian of quality, budget, BMW CI and brand standards, approvals and execution, liaising with BMW so that decisions reflect its requirements.
* Review and approve launch event concepts developed by the Training Co-ordinator, together with BMW.
* Lead the briefing for each launch or event, and feed approved concepts and decisions through to the team and external event suppliers.
* Support the team in the operational delivery of launches and events, as briefed.

**Vendor Oversight**

* Approve training vendors and programmes together with BMW and the BMW regional office.
* Produce a briefing document for supplier tender, or for a selected supplier to GP, setting out the programme requirement, key success factors, budget and timing, and appoint the supplier.
* Hold an annual review with each supplier, including written feedback from importers, participants and BMW where possible.

**People & Resource Management**

* Lead the BMW ME team to achieve its KPIs and SLA obligations.
* Manage the performance of direct reports, including objectives, quarterly conversations, reviews and performance improvement plans.
* Manage time sheets and approve leave and sickness for all Training Centre staff, and handle team escalations.
* Act as the escalation point for internal operational matters handled day to day by the Training Co-ordinator.
* Manage grievances and employee issues together with GP Strategies management.
* Manage the performance of employed and vendor trainers against SLA quality and conduct requirements.
* Sit in on training regularly to ensure employed and vendor trainers maintain training standards consistently, and give them feedback.
* Recruit staff, including CV review, interviews and scoring.
* Maintain a recruitment pipeline and back-up resource plan, and fill replacement or additional roles within 3 months.
* Replace trainers within 5 business days when required by BMW, or put interim mitigation in place.
* Support trainer capacity planning and allocation.
* Onboard and certify new or replacement trainers.
* Support trainer calibration, train-the-trainer and professional development.
* Seek opportunities to reward and recognise the team and vendor trainers.

**Ad Hoc Duties**

* Undertake additional duties associated with the successful delivery of the BMW ME training programme, as reasonably required by the Senior Director.

**Key Performance Measures**

The Programme / Project Manager is measured on the performance of the programme as a whole, including the SLA requirements in the BMW contract addendum effective 1 January 2027:

* Course fill-rate of at least 95% (minimum 8 participants where applicable) and delivery of the agreed annual training volume.
* Participant satisfaction of at least 90% per course, per trainer and as a monthly average.
* Complete course content readiness before every delivery.
* Recruitment and replacement within contractual timelines.
* Full local, legal and financial compliance, with no Material Breach events.
* Programme financial performance against budget and forecast, including full revenue recovery.
* Minimal SLA service credits, with Rectification Plans and claims submitted on time.

**Professional Competence**

No day is the same, so it is important that you can prioritise, manage your time successfully, and work both proactively and reactively.

* Strong programme and project management capability across multiple workstreams, markets and stakeholders.
* Proven financial control: budgets, forecasting, revenue recovery, cost-to-invoice reconciliation and commercial risk management.
* Experience managing to contractual SLAs and KPIs, including evidence-based claims and corrective action planning.
* Strong governance, risk and issue management.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, measurable programme plans.
* Confident management of senior client stakeholders, including leading formal client and account meetings.
* People leadership: performance management, recruitment and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to interpret training data and KPI reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Working knowledge of TMSi or another learning management system is advantageous.

**Personal Competence**

* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for results.
* Professional and confident with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High emotional intelligence and cultural awareness across diverse markets.
* Commercially minded, with strong attention to detail.
* Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Calm and decisive under pressure; manages competing priorities effectively.
* Builds trust and credibility with the client, the team and vendors.
* Positive, collaborative and solutions-focused.

Title: Project Manager – Water and Wastewater

The successful candidate will work with the Project Director and multidisciplinary teams across regional offices, act as the main point of contact for clients and authorities, and contribute to the growth of the Water business in the region. The role suits an experienced water engineer who is ready to combine technical judgment with full responsibility for project delivery.

**Responsibilities**

The successful candidate would have the following responsibilities:

Engineering & Technical

* Provide technical oversight of design development for water and wastewater treatment plants, desalination plants, pumping stations, potable water systems, stormwater drainage, sewerage and treated sewage effluent networks, and agree the design basis and performance criteria with the project team.

* Identify delivery risks early and direct mitigation and recovery actions.

* Act as the main point of contact for clients, government authorities, development partners, contractors and subconsultants.

* Coordinate with regional and international technical teams, work across different offices and manage remote team members.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers, promoting technical excellence and knowledge transfer.
* Support continuous improvement, lessons learned and the effective use of digital tools and data.

Business Development

* Support proposal preparation, including technical approach, methodology, resource plans and fee inputs.
* Build and maintain relationships with clients, delivery partners, contractors and regulators.
* Identify new project opportunities from ongoing assignments and follow them up with the business development team.

**Essential**

* 12-15 years of experience in water and wastewater infrastructure design and delivery, preferably within an engineering consultancy.
* Professional registration or chartered status with a recognised engineering body, such as P.Eng, CEng or an equivalent
* Experience managing consultancy assignments across feasibility studies, design, tender preparation, construction supervision and commissioning of water and wastewater treatment plants and networks.
* Solid understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes, engineering design principles and relevant local and international standards.
* Proven experience managing projects or substantial work packages within water infrastructure, delivering against time, cost, quality and safety objectives.
* Practical understanding of project controls, including programme, cost, forecasting, risk, change and performance reporting.
* Proven ability to act as the main point of contact for clients and key stakeholders, and to build effective relationships with clients, contractors and delivery partners.
* Commercial awareness, with the confidence to identify, manage and escalate delivery and contractual risks.
* Strong written and verbal communication in English, including technical report writing and client presentations.

**Preferred**

* Detail-oriented approach with strong ability to review technical documentation and identify design risks, inconsistencies, or improvement opportunities.
* Willingness to travel to client offices and project sites across the region.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multidisciplinary teams, coordinate multiple stakeholders and work with remote and international teams.
* A recognised project management qualification or progress toward professional accreditation.

Title: Senior Manager, Digital Health & Technology (Healthcare Sector Exp) 50013026
Description:
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Manager of Digital Health & Technology leads the definition, prioritisation and delivery readiness of QHC's healthcare digital, data and technology requirements. The role translates clinical, operational and corporate priorities into clear technology requirements, delivery roadmaps, information flows and reporting needs, while coordinating with QIC / QTech on solution design, architecture alignment, implementation planning and service readiness.
  
  
In a healthcare startup, technology is a critical enabler of clinical operations, reporting, integration and patient experience. The role supports prioritization of the systems required across Sports Medicine, Citywide Healthcare and IHN, and tracks technology dependencies, delivery risks and readiness requirements. Specifically, within Sport Medicine / Performance , technology is core infrastructure rather than a support afterthought: electronic health records, clinical and athlete-monitoring platforms, analytics and cybersecurity must be specified, procured, deployed and integrated to enable safe clinical delivery and evidence-based performance health.
  
  
The role works closely with clinical, operations, finance and enabling teams to translate business and clinical needs into healthcare technology and data requirements, coordinating with function owners and QTech to ensure solutions are aligned with healthcare requirements and that data is usable for decision-making. The role also supports technology quality assurance, readiness and compliance with relevant healthcare-specific technology and data requirements.

* Digital Health Strategy & Technology Requirements
* Implement approved QHC Digital Blueprint and define QHC's health technology requirements and digital roadmap across clinical, operational and enabling domains, aligned with the organization's startup priorities and target operating model

* Advise leadership on build-versus-leverage decisions across the QIC / QTech and partner ecosystem
* Coordinate with QTech and relevant function owners on interoperability and integration requirements across clinical, operational and administrative systems
* Data Management, Analytics & Business Intelligence
* Define QHC's healthcare data requirements, information flows, data ownership and reporting needs across functions
* Define and coordinate analytics and reporting requirements that support data-driven clinical, operational and leadership decision-making
* Track data availability, quality, ownership and reporting gaps, coordinating with function owners to ensure healthcare data is usable for decision-making
* Support reporting and data needs across the organization as capability matures
* QTech / QIC SLA & Vendor Service Delivery
* Define, establish and manage service-level agreements with QIC / QTech and technology partners, ensuring strong, accountable service delivery to QHC
* Monitor vendor and partner performance against SLAs and drive remediation where service falls short
* Act as the primary QHC coordination point with QTech and relevant technology stakeholders on healthcare-specific technology requirements and delivery priorities
* Cybersecurity, Data Privacy & Governance
* In coordination with QIC, embed cybersecurity, data privacy and information-governance controls across all platforms and data flows from the outset
* In coordination with QIC, ensure compliance with Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulations and applicable international standards
* In coordination with QIC, establish access controls, audit trails and incident-response readiness for health and personal data
* Deployment, Integration & Readiness
* Oversee deployment and integration readiness for all technology, ensuring systems are tested, secure and operational ahead of go-live milestones
* Coordinate healthcare-specific testing and readiness activities with QTech and relevant clinical and operational teams
* Track technology readiness against the enterprise activation roadmap
* Innovation & Digital Enablement
* Identify and introduce digital health innovations — telehealth, remote athlete monitoring, wearables and AI-assisted tools — aligned with partner best practice
* Pilot and scale digital solutions that enhance clinical quality, athlete outcomes and operational efficiency

**Requirements**
**EXPERIENCE & ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Health Informatics, Engineering, or a related field is required. A Master's degree and recognized certifications (e.g. health informatics, cybersecurity, TOGAF, ITIL, or vendor platform certifications
  
  
8+ years of progressive experience in digital health, healthcare IT, health informatics or technology delivery, including experience defining healthcare technology requirements, supporting EHR and healthcare platform delivery, and coordinating technology readiness in new or transforming organizations.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing technology vendors and SLAs, data management and analytics, and cybersecurity / data-privacy controls within a healthcare environment. Experience within accredited healthcare institutions (JCI, CBAHI) is an advantage.
  
  
Working knowledge of Saudi data-protection and healthcare information regulatory frameworks, and of interoperability and integration across clinical and administrative systems.

* Align services to the revenue motion. Connect Services with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success through services attach, migration offers, clean handoffs, and consistent scoping and estimating.
* Hire, train, and shift talent globally. Bring in modern SaaS delivery expertise, re-skill tenured talent, develop regional successors, and reshape roles for the future operating model.

* Mission-critical go-lives, worldwide. Own global playbooks, governance, escalation paths, follow-the-sun support, and executive intervention for at-risk deployments.
* Global cloud migration program. Lead migration of Octave's installed base to the cloud, including commercial offers, technical execution, customer change management, data residency, and migration tooling.

Title: IT Manager
Company: Dave Steel Company, a Walters Group Company
Description:
Since 1929, Dave Steel Company, a Walters Group Company, has primarily focused on industrial projects requiring expert fabrication, exceptional quality, and exemplary service across the United States. As Dave Steel grows and expands into new markets, we are seeking to welcome aspiring and driven individuals to our team who share our vision, mission and core values.

We are incredibly proud of our projects, *to name a few: Sierra Nevada Brewery in Asheville, NC, the Mission Hospital Cancer Center in Asheville, NC, The ASU End Zone in Boone, NC, and the Pratt Whitney Building in Asheville, NC.*

  

We're an AISC Certified Fabricator in business since 1929. We are committed to supporting and developing our teams. We also ensure a positive, safe, collaborative work environment with ample personal and career development opportunities.

If you want to be a part of our team–read on and apply. Even if you feel like you don’t meet all the criteria, please give it a shot, and still apply.

**Role Overview**

The IT Manager is the primary IT resource for Dave Steel, the U.S. division of Walters Group. Reporting to the VP, Digital & Technology at Walters Group, this hands-on position is responsible for day-to-day IT support, infrastructure administration, system reliability, and technical issue resolution across Dave Steel locations.

We are seeking an experienced technical generalist who is comfortable supporting employees, troubleshooting servers and networks, maintaining core infrastructure, responding to outages, and completing technical projects. The successful candidate will take ownership of local issues through resolution while communicating clearly with employees and escalating appropriately when additional expertise is required.

The position operates as part of the broader Walters Digital & Technology organization and works closely with specialists across networking, Microsoft 365, systems administration, cybersecurity, applications, and infrastructure. Walters Group establishes enterprise standards and technical direction, while the IT Manager implements and supports those standards within Dave Steel.

As the Dave Steel IT team grows, this position is expected to provide day-to-day leadership, mentoring, workload prioritization, and technical guidance to local IT support staff. The role does not require extensive formal management experience, but the successful candidate should demonstrate the ability and interest to lead and develop junior technical employees.

**This role is 100% on-site**.

**Key Responsibilities**

IT Support & Service Delivery

* Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day IT support at Dave Steel, providing responsive, hands-on assistance to employees and local leaders.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, phones, user accounts, applications, connectivity, and plant-floor technology.
* Own support requests through resolution, including communication, documentation, follow-up, and escalation to Walters Group specialists when required.
* Prioritize support activities based on business impact, urgency, and operational requirements.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding, device deployment, access changes, asset management, and related documentation.
* Create and maintain knowledge articles, technical procedures, and user documentation.

  

Systems & Infrastructure Administration

* Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware, networking, wireless, VPN, and related infrastructure.
* Support Microsoft 365 technologies including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Intune within established Walters Group standards.
* Coordinate and perform patching, maintenance, upgrades, equipment replacement, and routine infrastructure changes.
* Support backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures, including regular validation and documentation.
* Lead the on-site response to outages and operational technology issues, engaging Walters technical resources as required.

  

Security & Standards

* Implement and maintain Walters Group cybersecurity controls and technical standards within Dave Steel.
* Support endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, patch compliance, MFA, Conditional Access, system hardening, and access controls.
* Assist with security investigations and remediation activities under the direction of Walters Digital & Technology.
* Ensure systems and infrastructure changes follow established architecture, change-management, and security practices.

  

Support Leadership

* Provide day-to-day direction, mentoring, and technical guidance to local IT support staff as the team grows.
* Help prioritize support workload and ensure requests are followed through to resolution.
* Establish clear expectations for customer service, communication, documentation, and escalation.

  

Projects & Collaboration

* Participate directly in infrastructure upgrades, migrations, implementations, and other technology projects.
* Work closely with Walters Group subject matter experts on complex troubleshooting, technical standards, infrastructure changes, cybersecurity, and major incidents.
* Coordinate local work with technology vendors and service providers when required.
* Identify recurring issues, infrastructure risks, aging technology, and practical opportunities to improve reliability and support.
* Share documentation, technical knowledge, and operational practices across the broader Digital & Technology team.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

  

* 5+ years of progressive hands-on IT experience, including demonstrated responsibility for systems administration, infrastructure troubleshooting, and end-user support.
* College or university education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong experience supporting Windows-based, business-critical environments.
* Experience supporting multiple locations or an operational environment is preferred.
* Experience within manufacturing, construction, steel fabrication, or another operationally intensive environment is considered an asset.
* Previous experience mentoring, leading, or providing day-to-day direction to junior technical staff is preferred. Formal people-management experience is an asset but not required.

  

**Technical Skills**

Strong practical experience with:

* Windows Server and Active Directory.
* Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
* VMware or comparable virtualization platforms.
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, switching, VPNs, Wi-Fi, and firewall fundamentals.
* Backups, disaster recovery, endpoint management, and patching.
* Cybersecurity fundamentals, identity management, MFA, and access controls.
* Windows endpoints, mobile devices, printers, and common business applications.

**🛠 What You’ll Get Your Hands On**

Own the operational performance of grocery, supermarket, convenience, and quick-commerce partners.
  
  

* Ensure product availability, stock accuracy, pricing accuracy, and substitution processes are properly managed.
* Reduce missing items, wrong items, out-of-stock issues, and delayed grocery orders.

* Work with category, merchant, logistics, and product teams to improve the grocery customer journey.
* Build operating standards for grocery partners, including item accuracy, cold-chain sensitivity, packaging, and delivery readiness.
* Monitor grocery fulfillment time and customer complaint trends.
* Support the development of dark-store or quick-commerce models if required.
* Improve grocery basket experience, repeat purchase, and reliability.

Own the operational performance of laundry partners and end-to-end laundry order flow.
  
  

* Manage the full laundry journey from pickup to partner processing to delivery.
* Ensure clear SLAs for pickup, cleaning, ironing, packaging, and return delivery.
* Reduce delays, damaged items, missing items, wrong items, and customer complaints.
* Build quality control standards for laundry partners.
* Ensure proper item tagging, tracking, and handover processes.
* Work with product and logistics teams to improve scheduling, pickup windows, and customer notifications.
* Create escalation processes for high-value items, lost items, or damaged items.
* Improve customer trust in the laundry vertical through reliability, transparency, and service recovery.

Own the operational execution of ticketing services, events, bookings, and related customer experiences.
  
  

* Ensure ticket inventory, availability, pricing, and event details are accurate.
* Coordinate with event organizers, venues, partners, product, finance, and customer support.
* Manage operational readiness before, during, and after major events.
* Reduce customer issues related to ticket access, QR codes, refunds, cancellations, and event changes.
* Create clear SOPs for event-day support and escalation.
* Ensure smooth settlement and reporting with ticketing partners.
* Support major event launches with risk assessment and operational planning.
* Build scalable ticketing processes for future expansion into entertainment, experiences, sports, and tourism.

* Retail Operations

For flowers, pharmacies, electronics, beauty, gifts, fashion, and general retail partners.
  
  

* Improving item accuracy, merchant readiness, fulfillment time, packaging, and delivery handover.
* Reducing cancellations, unavailable items, wrong items, and poor packaging complaints.
* Building SOPs for sensitive categories such as pharmacy, flowers, electronics, and gifts.
* Supporting category-specific service standards.
* Marketplace Operations

Own the overall marketplace health across multiple verticals.
  
  

* Monitor supply availability across merchants and categories.
* Ensure strong coordination between merchant operations, logistics, product, and customer support.
* Improve operational KPIs across all marketplace verticals.
* Identify marketplace gaps such as low availability, weak fulfillment, poor merchant compliance, or high complaint rates.
* Support new vertical launches with proper operating models and readiness checks.
* New Vertical Launch Operations

Lead operational readiness for new Snoonu verticals before launch.
  
  

* Define the operating model for each new vertical.
* Build SOPs, SLAs, partner requirements, customer support flows, and escalation rules.
* Run pilot launches before scaling.
* Identify operational risks before public launch.
* Work with product to ensure the customer journey is ready.
* Work with finance to validate pricing, commission, refunds, and settlement processes.
* Ensure logistics capacity and delivery requirements are clear.

* Serve as the primary liaison and BHS Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the client and contractors, maintaining a polished, expert presence at all times.
* Lead and manage the on-site support team (including field/project engineering staff) for surveys, inspections, installations, functional assessments, and testing.
* Personally perform or directly support tactical, hands-on tasks as needed to meet client expectations and project pace, this is not a purely oversight-level role.
* Coordinate with Designers, Project Engineers, Directors, and Executives to assign staff and develop all required reports, specifications, drawing packages, and client submittals.
* Maintain project budgets and schedules to ensure timely, cost-effective completion.
* Review and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs); supervise punch list resolution and provide start-up assistance.
* Review functional assessments, technical reports, specifications, and drawing packages prepared by Project Engineers, and provide feedback to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Conduct and analyze system simulations for performance evaluation.
* Mentor and support Project Engineers and Designers, including managing workload and coverage across the site support team.
* Proactively manage the client relationship and expectations given the account's high-touch, service-intensive nature.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent field experience).
* 10+ years of project management experience, preferably within baggage handling systems (BHS), aviation, or large-scale airport infrastructure.
* Demonstrated leadership and team-building experience managing site support or field engineering teams.
* Exceptional client rapport, communication, and executive presence, this account requires a consistently polished, expert-level representative.
* Experience managing project logistics, timelines, and budgets.
* Demonstrated willingness and ability to perform tactical, hands-on tasks personally when the situation requires it, not solely delegate to junior staff.
* Based in, or able to relocate to, the Greater Toronto Area, with regular on-site presence at YYZ.
* Ability to pass criminal background checks and obtain/maintain airport security credentials (RAIC).

**Preferred**

* Civil or electrical engineering backgrounds, or other educational backgrounds with relevant knowledge/experience, will also be considered.
* Previous experience in conceptual and spatial coordination work with large-scale hub airports.
* PMP certification.

**Education**

* Advanced Engineering degree or equivalent field experience.
* PMP certification preferred but not required.

**Working Conditions**

* On-site support at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ); client offices adjacent to the airport campus.
* Some remote work is possible when direct site activities are not required, though frequent on-site presence is expected given client expectations.
* Standard 40-hour work week with occasional additional time required to meet deadlines.

Candidates must be legally entitled to work in Canada by the start date. BNP Associates is not able to support a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) or an employer-specific work permit for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer. BNP offers an excellent benefits package and competitive salaries, along with professional advancement opportunities.

Title: Senior Strategic Customer Success Manager
Description:
Managing pricing and rebates shouldn’t be a hassle. Enable’s intelligent platform is built for the speed of today’s market, eliminating disconnects between pricing strategy and rebate execution. We help companies to increase profitability and simplify the complex with accurate, AI-powered insights, real-time performance monitoring, agreement optimization, and simplified rebate management.

After securing $291M in Series A-D funding and acquiring Flintfox in 2025, Enable is positioned for continued, significant growth. Want a glimpse into life at Enable? Visit our **Life at Enable** page to learn how you can be part of our journey.

**Job Summary**
---------------

As a Senior Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will work with Enable’s (including Flintfox) largest and most complex customers to drive strategic growth across complex enterprise environments. This role requires building multi-threaded executive relationships, leading global account strategy, and elevating customers into long-term strategic partnerships by delivering value through positive business outcomes.  
  
You will own and execute the success strategy for your focused portfolio. You will champion strategic account planning excellence, joint executive sponsorship, thought leadership engagement, cross-functional orchestration, and a relentless focus on client success and value delivery.

This is a highly visible role, responsible for building trusted executive relationships, and developing Enable’s largest customers into long-term strategic partners. You will work across Enable to help customers realize measurable value, strengthen retention, and identify opportunities for sustainable account growth.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**
--------------------------------

#### **Global Account & Customer Success Leadership**

* Serve as the Global Organizational Client Touch Point, owning executive alignment across regions and business units.
* Build deep, trusted relationships with C-level executives, stakeholders and economic buyers, and be trusted as your customers’ strategic advisor to ensure retention and secure expansions.
* Establish and maintain joint executive sponsorship programs to elevate Enable from vendor to strategic partner.
* Develop champions and strengthen influence across the power structure within each account.
* Continuously learn and upskill yourself to become a rebate and pricing industry expert your customers can rely upon for best practices.

  

#### **Strategic Account Planning & Command Center Execution**
