Title: Service Desk Team Lead
Description:
**Job Summary**

The Service Desk Team Lead owns the day-to-day performance of the Service Desk and client satisfaction. You will lead a team of Level 1 and Level 2 helpdesk engineers, act as the team's technical escalation point, manage the team's workload so tickets are handled on time and to a high standard, and provide clear reporting on service desk health to the Vice President of Service Delivery.

**Duties**

* Lead, coach and develop a team of helpdesk engineers, including regular one-on-ones, performance feedback and onboarding of new team members
* Handle day-to-day people management: take part in hiring and interviews, run weekly team meetings, complete performance reviews, approve time off and plan shift coverage
* Manage the team's workload: monitor queues, assign and balance tickets, prioritize by urgency and impact, and plan coverage and schedules
* Make sure tickets meet SLA targets and quality standards, and step in on escalations and at-risk tickets
* Own escalation paths between Level 1, Level 2 and other Conpute teams, and make sure handoffs are clean
* Own and report on service desk KPIs, including SLA compliance, first response time, time to resolution, first contact resolution, ticket backlog, escalation rate, ticket reopen rate and customer satisfaction (CSAT)
* Produce regular reporting for the Sr. Director, including ticket volume, workload by engineer and recurring issues
* Use reporting and KPIs to identify trends, root causes and capacity needs, guide coaching and staffing decisions, and recommend improvements to the Sr. Director
* Own service desk documentation in IT Glue: keep SOPs, runbooks and escalation procedures accurate and current, and make sure engineers document their work
* Maintain and improve service desk processes and ticket quality
* Run the service desk day to day in Autotask and N-able RMM, including queues, tickets, SLAs and client alerts
* Act as the technical escalation point for the Service Desk, resolving complex issues that Level 1 and Level 2 engineers cannot, and as the point of contact for escalations from clients and internal teams
* Work with Account Management, Projects, and AI and Development to improve service delivery

**Qualifications**

* Experience working in a managed service provider (MSP) environment
* Previous management experience
* Direct experience managing a team of helpdesk engineers
* Demonstrated ability to manage team workload, queues and SLAs
* Experience tracking and reporting service desk KPIs and presenting results to senior leadership
* Hands-on experience with an MSP PSA, RMM and documentation platform
* Strong documentation habits, with experience maintaining SOPs, runbooks and knowledge base articles
* Strong hands-on technical skills across Microsoft 365, Windows, networking and common end-user and small business IT support, with a proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues and serve as the technical escalation point for a support team
* Clear written and verbal communication with clients and staff

**Preferred qualifications**

* Direct experience with Autotask, IT Glue and N-able RMM
* ITIL or similar service management training
* Microsoft certifications

* The Director is responsible for translating CPS strategic priorities into operational plans, optimizing resource utilization, developing high-performing leadership teams, and ensuring sustainable business performance.

* Establish standardized operating models, performance expectations, and governance structures to ensure consistency across teams and programs.
* Lead operational planning, resource allocation, capacity management, and workforce optimization to support current operations and future growth.

* Leverage operational data, performance metrics, and quality indicators to identify opportunities and drive strategic improvements.
* Establish appropriate risk management and escalation processes to proactively address operational challenges.

Description

**About Us**: Recognized as the trusted source for industry knowledge, LIMRA and LOMA provides research, training, development, and networking solutions to financial services companies. In a rapidly changing marketplace, companies rely on us for our industry insight, practical solutions, and unwavering commitment to their success.

* Research: Catalysts for new ideas, industry benchmarking, and strategic planning.
* Learning & Development: Programs to assess, train, and increase productivity, and develop future corporate leaders.
* Networking: Connections with industry leaders and peers through study groups, committees, and conferences.
  

**The Opportunity:** Members tell us that LIMRA and LOMA’s ability to bring them together to discuss and address common challenges is one of the key benefits of membership. These convening activities are core to what we do, with over a dozen conferences each year. Our goal is to continually enhance the value of members coming together to engage with each other and stay informed about what’s happening in the industry.
  
  
This role will be responsible for leading all facets of the convening function within the organization. This starts with developing and executing holistic strategies for member gatherings including defining best practices, establishing consistent approaches, and maintaining high standards for attendee experience at LIMRA and LOMA events as well as ensuring delivery of member-centric convening experiences to support the organization’s goal of advancing the financial services industry.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Develop the strategic vision for convening within our organization to increase member value and engagement as well as contribute to the organization’s long-term success. Continuously refresh the vision to stay contemporary with changes in our marketplace to meet evolving member needs.
* Gather, manage, and prioritize member needs and market opportunities; ensure such needs and opportunities are addressed through content and thematic focus of member gatherings.
* Perform competitive analyses and design of convening activities overall through market intelligence, and advise on long-term development of future events, solutions, and experiences.
* Collaborate successfully with key internal and external stakeholders, working as a team to achieve strategic objectives.
* Implement strategy on a day-to-day basis, with related business plans, budgets, and reporting, including annual analysis of the organization’s convening activities to ensure success.
* Manage revenue and expense budgets for all conferences, delivering a financially effective collection of conference experiences annually.
* Lead and develop the conferences and events teams, creating clarity around priorities, expectations, and measures of success while empowering leaders and team members to take ownership of execution and results.
* Establish best practices for convening, including evaluating the quality and value of each member gathering on a regular basis and expanding or sunsetting programs as appropriate.
* Facilitate thematic messaging and alignment of content and activities at member gatherings is consistent with the organization’s overall strategy and key member interests.
* Establish and maintain processes for capturing member feedback at conferences with subsequent sharing of information within the organization to help organization meet member needs. Utilize feedback to inform strategy and activities of convening functions, specifically.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key industry influencers and strategic partners.
* Introduce new and innovative approaches to enhance attendee experience at LIMRA and LOMA events; create and champion others’ breakthrough ideas and initiatives

**What You Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field; advanced degrees and certifications are a plus
* 10+ years of comprehensive (deep and broad) experience in roles related to convening an conference management
  + Financial services experience/knowledge is strongly preferred
  + Trade or professional association experience a plus
* 7+ years experience managing a team and as a leader of leaders
* Extensive experience success in building brand experiences through meetings and event management and sponsorship opportunities.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, including occasional weekend travel
* CMP certification preferred

**What Do You Need To Succeed?**

* Deep understanding of conference management with a proven track record of success in delivering programs with highly valued content and profitably growing an organization’s conference/convening business.
* Aptitude to think about and plan the future with imagination and wisdom to creatively evolve brand and presence in convening; ability to identify new opportunities and incorporate into vision and plan of action.
* Ability to interface with colleagues and industry professionals at all levels, and influence peers and others without direct authority in order to achieve desired impact and results.
* Ability to build collaborative and trusted relationships across teams and with key stakeholders. Listens actively, seeks to understand different perspectives, and creates meaningful opportunities for others to contribute to decisions and solutions.
* Bias for action and execution, balanced with sound judgment and an understanding of when to seek input and build alignment. Removes barriers to success, drives accountability, and maintains momentum toward shared objectives.
* Strong leadership skills with demonstrated success developing individuals, teams, and other leaders. Leads with humility and curiosity, actively seeks input, and leverages the expertise of others. Successfully leads change by building understanding and ownership around change and clearly communicating the “why,” inviting different perspectives, and bringing people along as the organization evolves.
* Ability to pivot between strategic vision and tactical focus as appropriate and be decisive even when confronted with limited information.
* Ability to anticipate members’ needs, as well as incorporate member feedback into action plans to optimize effectiveness of member gatherings.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Works cooperatively with others across the organization to achieve shared objectives.
* Executive presence and influence.
* Understand and advance the organization’s mission; ability to “connect the dots” between key messages and activities at an organizational level, within the convening functions.
* Strategic thinking translated into action – Ability to align delivery outcomes with enterprise goals and long-term vision.
* Excellent presentation skills including being able to effectively communicate the LIMRA and LOMA convening value proposition.
* Decision-making, prioritization, and trade-off management.
* Good organization, attention to detail, and follow-up skills as well as strong project and budget management capabilities, ensuring adherence to timelines and delivery against key milestones.
* Strong negotiation skills.
* Lead with our ICARE values and coach others to do so as well. Demonstrate sound professional judgment and competence.

**Attributes:**
  
  
Adaptable. Responds resourcefully to new demands and challenges.
  
  
Passionate. Self-starts and stays highly motivated to achieve aggressive goals. Shares contagious energy and enthusiasm liberally. Maintains an insatiable appetite for progress and excellence.
  
  
Leads with curiosity and a service mindset. Listens first, values the expertise and contributions of others, and seeks feedback without defensiveness. Learns, adapts, and improves continuously.
  
  
Shares credit, recognizes others’ contributions, and creates opportunities for others to succeed.
  
  
Integrity-centered. Is trustworthy, truthful, and transparent in all aspects of work. Keeps commitments to external and internal parties. Holds self strictly accountable.
  
  
Respectful. Appreciates the benefits of different backgrounds and perspectives. Integrates different ideas. Places customers' and team members' interests ahead of own interests.
  
  
Entrepreneurial. Rolls up sleeves and is hands-on where needed. Sees opportunity and pursues full potential. Works quickly, intelligently, and flexibly.
  
  
Visionary - looks forward and creatively evolves brand and presence in the convening market. Has a visionary and creative approach to achieve goals.

For 50 years, the Food Bank, made up of a diverse staff, dedicated Board of Directors and passionate volunteers, has been leading the fight to end hunger in partnership with our community and in service of our neighbors in need.

**About this Opportunity**

The IT Manager supports the day-to-day operations of technology infrastructure, systems, and support at FBCCS, ensuring that staff across both locations have the reliable tools they need to fulfill the Food Bank’s mission of ending hunger. Reporting to the VP of Operations and Programs, this role manages vendor relationships and IT security tasks assigned by the VP and helps drive continuous improvement in how technology enables program delivery and operational effectiveness. The IT Manager collaborates across departments to support execution of the technology strategy set by the VP of Operations and Programs, serving as the lead of our managed service provider (MSP) and technology vendor relationships and as the user-facing contact for our technology, software, and training.

**Essential Duties**

* Lead technology vendor relationships, including the managed service provider (MSP), and implement the technology strategy set by the VP of Operations and Programs. This covers computers, printers, software, connectivity, phones, door access, cameras and other security systems.

* Serve as the primary MSP point of contact. Coordinate support tickets and escalations, monitor service level agreement (SLA) performance and review recurring issues in regular check-ins. Keep the VP of Operations and Programs informed of performance and concerns.

* Administer delegation-of-authority thresholds set by the VP for routine IT purchasing and change approvals across departments. Escalate decisions above the threshold to the VP of Operations and Programs.

* Administer IT vendor contracts and support the IT budget. Use MSP inventory and lifecycle reports to forecast needs and buy ahead of organizational requirements.

* Own the day-to-day staff experience of Food Bank technology, including Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, workstations, phones, printers and line-of-business applications. Work with the MSP and vendors to keep these systems reliable, secure, available and optimized.

* Serve as technical administrator for enterprise applications, including Ceres (Navision) and Salesforce. Manage user provisioning and access, integrations, system performance, change management and platform support. Coordinate with vendors (including Wye and Salesforce partners) and with the MSP on security, hosting and backups.

* Lead the business side of infrastructure projects assigned by the VP of Operations and Programs, such as the SharePoint and Intune migrations to a cloud-only environment, the Privileged Access Management rollout and the network hardware refresh. Coordinate scope, timelines and department impact with MSP engineers.

* Oversee cybersecurity controls with the MSP, including identity management, multi-factor authentication, endpoint protection, network security, backups, disaster recovery and incident response. Support security audits and investigations, and review MSP security, backup and disaster recovery reports.

* Monitor IT infrastructure performance using MSP dashboards and reports. Evaluate proposals for feasibility and recommend process improvements and new or updated hardware and software.

* Deploy and maintain technology policies, standards and protocols, including SaaS acceptable use, and support the Data and AI Governance Lead’s AI acceptable-use policy.

* Partner with the Data and AI Governance Lead so enterprise systems support data quality, governance, reporting, compliance and responsible AI use. Provision, secure and budget approved AI tools, and monitor for unapproved AI and SaaS use.

* Coordinate technology training with the MSP, vendors and the Data and AI Governance Lead. This includes new-hire onboarding, refresher training, security awareness, new tool rollouts, and approved AI tools and policy. Salesforce training stays with the Data Committee.

Title: Associate Project Director (Residential)

• Overseeing the end-to-end project management and delivery of major new-build residential assets from concept design through pre-contract, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.

• Providing early project management oversight across the development and design functions, ensuring development objectives are translated into clear and deliverable project requirements.
  
• Coordinating with the PMC design managers and architect, design consultants, specialist consultants and wider multidisciplinary project team to ensure design deliverables are achieved against key milestones.

• Supporting and coordinating the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support the required commercial launch dates.
  
• Supervising the fast-track delivery of the sales center, managing interfaces between design, procurement, approvals and construction to achieve an accelerated programme and then the delivery of several high-end residential apartment buildings.
  
• Developing and maintaining the project execution plan, master programme, risk register, governance structure and project reporting requirements.
  
• Managing procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, programme and project risk.
  
• Transitioning the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintaining continuity of project leadership throughout delivery.
  
• Managing consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against programme, cost, quality and contractual requirements.
  
• Monitoring project performance, identifying emerging risks and implementing recovery or mitigation measures where required.
  
• Providing clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on programme, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions and delivery status.
  
• Maintaining stakeholder relationships and creating strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement and construction teams.
  
• Maintaining strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved.

• Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project.
  
• Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover.
  
• Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programmes and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones.
  
• Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement and physical delivery.

• Strong programme management skills with experience identifying programme risk, challenging consultant performance and implementing recovery strategies.
  
• Demonstrable procurement, contract, commercial, risk and change-management experience.
  
• Strong client-facing and senior stakeholder-management capability, including the confidence to operate effectively within a high-profile project subject to significant executive scrutiny.

• A degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, project management or a related discipline.
  
• Professional membership such as RICS, CIOB, APM or equivalent would be advantageous, consistent with Mace's established SPM criteria.
  
• Previous experience delivering major residential developments in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be advantageous.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.

* Strong interest in mobility, solid understanding of leading and emerging mobile technologies along with working knowledge of Android, Apple & Windows Operating Systems

* A quick learner with the ability to comprehend and explain complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences
* Solid communication skills along with the ability to build and manage relationships with large enterprises
* Experience in technical documentation

Title: Manager, Forbes on Fifth
Description:
Forbes is an iconic global media brand that has symbolized success for over a century. Fueled by journalism that informs and inspires, Forbes spotlights the doers and doings shaping industries, achieving success and making an impact on the world. Forbes connects and convenes the most influential communities ranging from billionaires, business leaders and rising entrepreneurs to creators and innovators. The Forbes brand reaches more than 140 million people monthly worldwide through its trusted journalism, signature ForbesLive events and 49 licensed local editions in 81 countries.

Forbes is seeking a hands-on, hospitality-first manager to oversee the day-to-day readiness and operations of Forbes on Fifth, our flagship New York event venue. Reporting to the Vice President, ForbesLive, this individual will serve as the venue's primary on-site steward. They will ensure the space is polished, clean, well maintained, operationally sound, and fully prepared to host a wide range of internal, editorial, partner, licensee, and revenue-generating events.

This is a highly visible, five-day-per-week on-site role for an organized, proactive operator who can balance premium hospitality standards, event logistics, facility coordination, and stakeholder service. The Manager will independently lead non-revenue event operations and partner closely with the ForbesLive team to support venue operations for revenue-generating programs.

**Responsibilities:**

*Venue Readiness, Maintenance & Hospitality*

* Serve as the day-to-day operational steward of Forbes on Fifth, maintaining a consistently polished, welcoming, and event-ready environment.
* Conduct regular venue walkthroughs to identify maintenance, cleanliness, safety, furniture, technology, supply, and presentation needs before they affect an event or guest experience.
* Coordinate the timely resolution of facility-related issues with Corporate Facilities, building management, cleaning partners, and other outside service providers.
* Maintain clear visibility into ongoing repairs, preventive maintenance needs, venue improvements, and service requests, escalating issues appropriately and following through to completion.
* Ensure all guest-facing and back-of-house areas are clean, organized, well stocked, and aligned with Forbes' hospitality standards.
* Anticipate each day's space, hospitality, and operational needs based on the venue calendar, including room resets, furniture configurations, supplies, deliveries, and staffing.
* Manage venue-specific inventory, including event furnishings, supplies, signage, hospitality materials, and beverage inventory.
* Coordinate the receipt, storage, tracking, distribution, and return of event materials, shipments, samples, books, signage, and other venue-related assets.

*Calendar, Space Booking & Stakeholder Service*

* Own and maintain the master calendar for Forbes on Fifth, ensuring all reservations, holds, changes, room assignments, and event details are accurate and current.
* Serve as the central point of contact for venue requests, confirming availability, gathering required event information, and managing the intake process from initial inquiry through final confirmation.
* Coordinate room assignments and resolve scheduling conflicts in partnership with stakeholders and ForbesLive leadership.
* Lead venue walkthroughs and planning conversations with internal teams, partners, licensees, and other event stakeholders.
* Translate stakeholder needs into practical venue plans, including room layouts, hospitality requirements, audio/visual needs, staffing, security, catering, photography, and load-in requirements.

*Non-Revenue Event Management*

* Independently manage end-to-end venue operations for non-revenue events, including internal programs, content productions, and licensee events, and other approved uses of the space.
* Develop and manage detailed event logistics, including vendor timelines, floor plans, room setups, service orders, delivery schedules, load-in, event-day operations, load-out, and room reset.
* Coordinate with vendors and stakeholders to ensure all event elements are delivered to a high standard and within approved scope and budget.
* Support invitations, guest-facing materials, event signage, and other event deliverables as needed.
* Maintain calm, responsive, solutions-oriented leadership on event days, ensuring guests, stakeholders, and vendors have a seamless experience.

*ForbesLive Event Support*

* Partner with ForbesLive producers and event leads to serve as the venue operations lead for revenue-generating programs hosted at Forbes on Fifth.
* Support venue readiness, vendor access, room setup, hospitality, deliveries, load-in, load-out, and post-event reset for ForbesLive events.
* Coordinate closely with the ForbesLive team to ensure event operations are aligned with approved production plans, client commitments, and guest experience standards.
* Provide knowledgeable, on-site support to help the ForbesLive team execute efficiently in the space.

*Vendor, Financial & Compliance Coordination*

* Maintain strong working relationships with preferred venue vendors across audio/visual, catering, staffing, security, furniture rental, photography, cleaning, and other operational needs.
* Request and evaluate vendor quotes, prepare event cost estimates, and coordinate event-related expenses with stakeholders before services are confirmed.
* Track invoices, receipts, event costs, and budget codes, partnering with Finance to support accurate chargebacks, billing, and expense reconciliation.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding and renewal processes with Legal, Finance, Facilities, and building management, including agreements, rate cards, certificates of insurance, and other required documentation.
* Support responsible management of hospitality and beverage inventory, including ordering, post-event counts, replenishment, and cost allocation in accordance with company policy.

*Systems, Standards & Continuous Improvement*

* Build and maintain venue operating procedures, event checklists, intake forms, vendor guides, floor-plan standards, inventory records, and other tools that create consistency and scalability.
* Identify opportunities to improve the venue experience, reduce operational friction, strengthen vendor performance, and elevate service standards.
* Establish clear handoffs and communication practices across ForbesLive, Facilities, Finance, Legal, Editorial, Licensing, and other internal teams.

**The Ideal Candidate:**

* Experience in venue operations, event operations, hospitality, facilities coordination, hotel operations, or a comparable high-touch guest environment.
* Experience overseeing a premium event venue, hospitality space, cultural institution, corporate event space, hotel, restaurant, or similar setting.
* A hospitality-first mindset with exceptional attention to cleanliness, presentation, detail, and guest experience.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple events, stakeholder requests, vendors, deadlines, and competing priorities at once.
* Strong knowledge of event logistics, including catering, audio/visual, security, staffing, furniture, load-in/load-out, and room setup.
* Experience preparing event estimates, managing invoices and receipts, tracking expenses, and coordinating budget codes or chargebacks.
* Strong vendor-management skills, including quotes, service standards, insurance documentation, contracts, and renewals.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment and discretion to work effectively with senior executives, partners, clients, and outside vendors.
* Proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and comfortable solving problems in real time.
* Ability to perform essential on-site responsibilities, including coordinating deliveries, overseeing room resets, and managing hands-on venue needs.
* Availability to work on-site five days per week, with flexibility for occasional early mornings, evenings, and weekends based on the event calendar.

This role may evolve over time. While this job description outlines the primary responsibilities, additional duties may be assigned as business needs change.

Title: Director of IT
Description:
Success starts at Community College of Philadelphia. Innovators and difference makers work at Community College of Philadelphia. Diversity thrives at Community College of Philadelphia. We are a college that is committed to promoting a work environment that attracts and retains talented and diverse faculty and staff. We challenge each other and ourselves to achieve at the highest level while contributing to the mission of the College and the betterment of Philadelphia. We value and support an intellectually dynamic community to prepare our students for global citizenship. Join us and become a part of a community that has long been and will continue to be generators of generational chance in this city and beyond.
  
  
Community College of Philadelphia is an open-admission, associate-degree-granting institution which provides access to higher education for all who may benefit. Its programs of study in the liberal arts and sciences, career technologies, and basic academic skills provide a coherent foundation for college transfer, employment and lifelong learning. The College serves Philadelphia by preparing its students to be informed and concerned citizens, active participants in the cultural life of the city, and enabled to meet the changing needs of business, industry and the professions. To help address broad economic, cultural and political concerns in the city and beyond, the College draws together students from a wide range of ages and backgrounds and seeks to provide the programs and support they need to achieve their goals.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, Information Technology Support, provides strategic and operational leadership for the planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of the College's technology infrastructure, support services, telecommunications and enterprise technology operations. In partnership with the Associate Vice President of Information Technology Services and other College leaders, the Director advances institutional goals through effective technology planning, cybersecurity governance, compliance, business continuity, vendor management and the implementation of innovative technology services and solutions. The Director leads and develops technical support staff, manages operational and capital resources, and promotes culture of collaboration, accountability, and exceptional customer service. By aligning technology services with the College's academic and administrative priorities, the Director ensures secure, reliable, and cost effective technology solutions that support student success, employee productivity, institutional effectiveness.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Responsible for providing day-to-day planning, management, and administration of the College's Information Technology Support solutions; this includes research and development of proposed campus solutions, technical delivery, contract compliance, and effective resource management.
* Monitor and support institutional cybersecurity initiatives including risk management, vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, access management, security awareness training, incident response and business continuity coordination efforts, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Provide strategic oversight of cloud-based technologies, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and software-as-a-service solutions to ensure security, reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve IT service management processes, service level objectives, operational metrics, and customer experience initiatives utilizing industry best practices.
* Collaborate with institutional leadership to support compliance with applicable federal, state, and industry requirements including FERPA, GLBA, ADA accessibility standards, cybersecurity regulations, and College policies.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators, operational dashboards, and service metrics t measure effectiveness, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.
* Evaluate emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, and digital service innovations for their potential to improve institutional effectiveness, enhance IT services, and reduce operational costs.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, and College management, develop and review all RFPs for the procurement of hardware and software for technology initiatives College-wide; assist in implementing the initiatives contained in the Technology Plan specific to the Technical Support Services area to enhance institutional effectiveness and cost efficiencies.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS assists in developing and administering ITS division processes and procedures, and disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Provide leadership, coordination, planning, and integrative management of the College-wide voice and data communications systems, telecommunications administration and support, and network/database administration; ensure that the voice and data infrastructure meets reliability and availability standards as stated in the College’s Technology Plan.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, review, recommend, and implement policies, standards, and guidelines within the area of responsibility including classroom technology delivery and support.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop, review and monitor contracts, consultants and relationships with Technical Support Services related vendors within the ITS division.
* Manage projects assigned by AVP of ITS by providing advice, guidance and problem-solving; coordinate with division managers, and direct and monitor the work of project teams to ensure project deliverables and timelines are met.
* Direct operations for Technical Support Services by executing production tasks according to a documented schedule that meets or exceeds customer expectations.
* Convey technology options and solution recommendations to AVP of ITS in support of ITS planning and development.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS and the Director of ERP, develop customer service initiatives based upon analysis of end user feedback data. Make recommendations for continuous improvement.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop and manage operating and capital budget related to Technical Support services to support goals, functions, programs, and services.
* Coordinate with the College purchasing department on technology procurements; oversee lease replacement and maintenance schedules for asset management; monitor contracts, consultants, and relationships with vendors as related to Technical Support services.
* Provide strategic leadership, coaching, mentoring, accountability, and professional development opportunities for assigned staff while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, customer service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational effectiveness.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, participate in the selection, evaluation and discipline of subordinate staff; establish and assign staff workload and projects, develop and monitor performance standards, conduct training and evaluate performance.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, monitor new technologies and assess their potential for solving College-wide initiatives and/or delivery of new services.
* Deliver quality customer services to both internal and external constituents in a professional, helpful, and courteous manner.
* Participate in college-wide committees as directed by the AVP of ITS.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum seven (7) years of progressively responsible information technology leadership experience.
* Minimum five (5) years of supervisory or management experience leading technical teams.
* Experience in higher education, public sector, or similarly complex organizations preferred.
* Experience managing enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity programs, technology support, ITSM services, and vendor relationships preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience in creating and monitoring formal project plans required.
* Required skills and certifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, CCNA or equivalent
* The ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment is required.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment in evaluating situations and making assessments for required decisions.
* Strong orientation to planning, customer service, assertive decision-making, and reconciling conflicting needs is required.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to manage a full scope of services in a unionized environment are required.
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with issues that affect operations, policy, funding, and budgets in a mid-to-large organization is required.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze, design, test, implement, and document complex solutions for assigned clients and/or systems is required.
* Ability to maintain sensitivity, understanding, and respect for a diverse academic environment, inclusive of students, faculty, and staff of varying social, economic, cultural, ideological, and ethnic backgrounds is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Relevant professional certifications in cybersecurity, governance, project management, IT service management, collaboration technologies, cloud communications, infrastructure, networking, and enterprise architecture are highly preferred. Examples include CISSP, CISM, CGEIT, CRISC, PMP, CAPM, Agile, ITIL, Microsoft Teams Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, and CCNP Enterprise.

Title: Technical Services Manager
Description:
**Job Overview:**

Primoris Energy Services is seeking a Technical Services Manager (TSM) to lead project technical support across Field Engineering, Workface Planning, and Completions. This position connects engineering information with field execution by ensuring construction teams have the drawings, technical direction, work packages, and turnover documentation needed to perform their work.

The TSM partners with project management, construction, engineering, QA/QC, document control, subcontractors, and client representatives. The role provides daily leadership to assigned Technical Services personnel while implementing PES standards and supporting project safety, quality, schedule, and cost objectives.

**\*\*Team Leadership and Project Coordination\*\***

* Lead assigned Field Engineering, Workface Planning, and Completions personnel, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, and performance expectations.
* Evaluate staffing needs, support recruiting and onboarding, and coach employees in technical execution and professional development.
* Coordinate with project leadership and PES Technical Services leadership to resolve resource gaps, technical risks, and execution issues.
* Establish measurable performance indicators and report progress, constraints, and corrective actions.

**\*\*Field Engineering\*\***

* Manage the identification, documentation, and resolution of field technical issues, including RFIs, drawing discrepancies, and construction interfaces.
* Coordinate with the Engineer of Record and project engineering team to obtain approved technical direction.
* Oversee technical support for material takeoffs, procurement packages, installation planning, testing, and field documentation.
* Maintain traceability between approved changes, field redlines, and final as-built records.
* Ensure field personnel work from current, approved documents and that deviations receive the required review and authorization.

\*\*Workface Planning\*\*

* Oversee development and maintenance of Installation Work Packages aligned with construction priorities and the project schedule.
* Coordinate readiness reviews covering engineering, materials, access, equipment, labor, permits, safety, quality, and predecessor work.
* Maintain visibility of constraints, assign resolution responsibilities, and escalate issues affecting planned work.
* Work with construction supervision to ensure packages are practical, complete, and ready for field execution.

**\*\*Completions and Turnover\*\***

* Lead planning for systemization, completion tracking, walkdowns, punch management, and turnover documentation.
* Coordinate with construction, QA/QC, the client, and commissioning representatives to establish completion requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure required inspection records, test documentation, and supporting evidence are complete and traceable.
* Manage readiness for contractual completion milestones and turnover, including mechanical completion where applicable.
* Support commissioning interfaces within the contracted scope and defined responsibilities.

**\*\*Systems and Document Control\*\***

* Ensure project technical records are maintained in Autodesk Construction Cloud/Autodesk Forma and other approved project systems.
* Coordinate with Document Control to maintain document status, revision control, and distribution.
* Support adoption of approved digital workflows and reliable project reporting.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in industrial, power generation, or comparable heavy construction.
* Progressive responsibility in Field Engineering, Workface Planning, Completions, or related technical project execution, including experience leading personnel.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical requirements, and construction schedules.
* Working knowledge of RFIs, change documentation, work packaging, construction readiness, testing records, and turnover requirements.
* Proven ability to coordinate across disciplines, resolve issues, and hold teams accountable for commitments.
* Strong written communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Degree in engineering, construction management, construction science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and construction experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting EPC and construction-only projects.
* Familiarity with Advanced Work Packaging and multidisciplinary construction.
* Experience with Autodesk Construction Cloud/Forma, completions management systems, and project reporting tools.
* Experience developing employees, establishing execution standards, and managing technical support through project closeout.

**Work Environment**

This position supports active construction projects and requires field participation, project travel or assignment, and work schedules consistent with project needs.

The TSM coordinates construction technical execution. Design approval remains with the authorized engineering organization, and project management retains overall responsibility for project delivery.

**Company Overview:**

Primoris Energy Services is a major direct-hire contractor in the U.S. delivering self-performed turnkey industrial construction and EPC services. We offer these services to our clients within the refining, gas processing, chemical/petrochemical, hydrogen, power generation, mining, pulp and paper industries from the first groundbreaking activity all the way through commissioning and start-up of the project. Primoris forms a partnership with our customers and major stakeholders from early-stage engineering through construction completion and commercial operation, safely, on-time, and within budget.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation, paid weekly.
* Best-in-class medical, dental, vision, and LTD/STD coverage.
* 401(k) with company match, vested on day one.
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan [ESPP].
* Pet coverage for your furry friends.
* Legal assistance coverage.
* Award-winning safety programs.

Title: Deputy Director of Communications
Description:
**About the Organization:**

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation (OCABR) is a state agency within the Executive Office of Economic Development and is responsible for protecting consumers through advocacy and education. The Office of Consumer Affairs works to ensure that the businesses our agencies regulate treat all Massachusetts consumers fairly. The Division of Banks ("DOB"), Division of Insurance ("DOI"), Division of Occupational Licensure ("DOL"), Division of Standards ("DOS"), and Department of Telecommunications and Cable ("DTC") all fall under the OCABR umbrella and help us to fulfill our critical mission of building better businesses and smarter consumers.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to creating and sustaining a work culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and mutually respectful to all its employees regardless of race, color, age, creed, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran or disability status. We strive to reflect diversity in all facets and levels of our agency. The Office or Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation values inclusiveness and diversity within their employee and management teams. Within our community we strive to create and maintain working and learning environments that are inclusive, equitable, and welcoming.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel respected, valued, and empowered to maximize their skills and talents to serve our citizens.

**About the Role:**

The Deputy Director of Communications serves in a senior strategic communications and policy advisory capacity within the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation, providing leadership in the formulation, development, evaluation, and implementation of agency-wide communications policies, strategic initiatives, and organizational priorities across OCABR and its five component agencies. Working in close collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and agency leadership, the Deputy Director exercises substantial independent judgment and participates meaningfully in executive-level policy development and strategic decision-making to advance the mission and priorities of OCABR, the Executive Office, and the Governor's Office.

The Deputy Director participates substantially in the development and evaluation of agency policies, strategic goals, and major program initiatives, providing substantive analysis and recommendations that inform executive leadership decisions. The position independently evaluates proposed policies and initiatives, identifies communications implications, public engagement considerations, and potential policy concerns, and recommends modifications that support agency objectives and organizational priorities. The Deputy Director represents the communications function in executive-level policy discussions and serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on matters involving public policy, regulatory initiatives, consumer protection, licensing programs, legislative developments, and other issues affecting OCABR and its component agencies.

The Deputy Director develops and directs comprehensive communications strategies and initiatives, including media relations, digital communications, agency websites, social media, public information campaigns, executive messaging, visual communications, and performance evaluation. The position exercises independent judgment in establishing communications priorities, developing messaging strategies, and advising executive leadership on sensitive or high-profile matters. Responsibilities include directing the development and review of official agency communications, executive briefings, policy statements, speeches, talking points, press releases, consumer alerts, public guidance, and educational materials to ensure consistency with agency policies, strategic objectives, and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

The position manages and coordinates communications efforts including the OCABR and agency websites, social media accounts, media inquiries, press outreach, educational content, videos, event presentations, and executive briefing materials.

The Deputy Director assists with the annual communications plan, supports leadership and agencies with consumer alerts, guidance, and policy briefs, and helps manage all internal and public communications related to policies, regulations, legislative matters, legal issues, consumer protection and licensing programs, visual communication, and branding.

The Deputy Director provides strategic oversight of media relations activities and coordinates responses to complex or sensitive press inquiries and public records requests in consultation with OCABR leadership, legal counsel, and designated records custodians. The position evaluates communications risks, recommends appropriate agency responses, and advises executive leadership on matters affecting public messaging and agency policy. In coordination with legal counsel and appropriate program personnel, the Deputy Director reviews sensitive information and provides recommendations concerning disclosure considerations and potential redactions, consistent with applicable public records laws and agency procedures.

The Deputy Director develops and directs strategic public engagement and outreach initiatives in collaboration with the Community Outreach Supervisor, Director of Communications, and agency leadership. The position participates in establishing outreach priorities, developing stakeholder engagement strategies, and directing communications activities associated with executive events, public forums, webinars, and other agency initiatives. The Deputy Director advises executive leadership on opportunities to advance agency policy objectives through public engagement and evaluates the effectiveness of outreach strategies to recommend improvements to agency-wide communications and engagement priorities.

The Deputy Director, working with Community Outreach Supervisor, additionally advises on community outreach planning and execution and the preparation of all materials used in community outreach activities; the Deputy Director will regularly attend community outreach events and coordinate participation of agencies comprising the Office.

The Deputy Director serves as the designated acting representative for the Director of Communications when assigned, assuming delegated strategic, operational, and decision-making responsibilities necessary to maintain continuity of the communications function. The position provides direction and oversight to communications co-ops and interns, including assigning work, establishing priorities, monitoring performance, and coordinating daily activities, consistent with delegated supervisory authority. In carrying out these responsibilities, the Deputy Director routinely handles sensitive, privileged, or otherwise protected information and exercises discretion in safeguarding such materials in accordance with applicable laws and agency policies.

The Deputy Director performs other related duties as assigned, consistent with the position's responsibilities and delegated authority.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Communications and Agency-Wide Policy Development:** Develop, establish, and direct agency-wide strategic communications policies, priorities, and initiatives for the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation. Exercise substantial independent judgment and decision-making authority in formulating communications strategies, determining messaging priorities, and establishing standards governing media relations, social media, website content and improvements, visual communications, and performance analytics. Direct the development and implementation of major communications initiatives to advance OCABR's mission, ensure consistency with agency policy objectives, and maintain compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on communications policy, emerging issues, reputational considerations, and public engagement priorities.
* **Executive Policy Development and Strategic Communications:** Participate substantially in the formulation, development, and establishment of agency-wide policies, strategic goals, and organizational objectives in collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, and Deputy Undersecretary, ensuring alignment with the priorities and policy directives of the Executive Office and Governor's Office. Exercise independent judgment in evaluating policy initiatives, advising executive leadership on strategic communications considerations, and developing agency-wide communications strategies that advance established policy objectives. Direct and oversee the development of executive communications, including policy statements, speeches, remarks, talking points, video scripts, public outreach plans, press releases, and other official communications, ensuring consistency with agency priorities and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Represent the communications function in executive-level, programmatic, and legal policy discussions, providing substantive recommendations that influence agency policy development, implementation strategies, and public communications priorities.
* **Strategic Media Relations, Public Records, and Executive Advisory Responsibilities:** Develop, establish, and direct strategic media relations initiatives, policies, and protocols in coordination with OCABR executive leadership, agency leadership, and legal counsel. Exercise substantial independent judgment in evaluating and managing high-profile, sensitive, and complex media inquiries, determining appropriate communications strategies, and advising executive leadership on matters affecting agency policy, public messaging, and reputational considerations. Oversee the coordination and preparation of official media responses and public records requests (PRRs) originating from media organizations, collaborating with legal counsel and relevant program areas to ensure compliance with applicable public records laws, confidentiality requirements, and agency policies. Evaluate sensitive records and recommend appropriate disclosure and redaction considerations in consultation with legal counsel and designated records custodians. Establish media engagement priorities, direct proactive and responsive press activities, monitor emerging media issues, and provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership regarding communications risks, policy implications, and agency responses.
* **Strategic Public Engagement, Executive Events, and Outreach Policy:** Develop, establish, and direct strategic agency-wide public engagement, outreach, and executive event initiatives in collaboration with the Director of Communications, Community Outreach Supervisor, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and Commissioners. Exercise substantial independent judgment in establishing event priorities, developing strategic outreach objectives, and determining communications approaches that advance OCABR's policy goals and organizational mission. Advise executive leadership on public engagement strategies, emerging policy issues, and opportunities to strengthen stakeholder relationships and advance agency initiatives. Direct the planning, development, and execution of high-profile in-person and virtual events, including executive briefings, public forums, webinars, and stakeholder engagement activities. Oversee the preparation of policy research, executive briefing materials, event messaging, promotional strategies, and logistical coordination to ensure alignment with agency-wide policy priorities. Collaborate with executive leadership and program administrators to evaluate outreach effectiveness and recommend strategic adjustments to agency engagement policies and priorities.
* **Agency Policy Formulation, Strategic Analysis, and Executive Decision Support:** Participate substantially in the formulation, evaluation, and development of agency-wide policies, strategic initiatives, and major programs, exercising independent judgment and providing substantive recommendations that influence executive-level policy decisions. Serve as a strategic communications advisor to OCABR executive leadership, contributing to the development and refinement of agency policies, organizational priorities, and major program initiatives to ensure alignment with the agency's mission and the policy objectives of the Executive Office and Governor's Office. Independently evaluate proposed policies, programs, and strategic initiatives; identify communications implications, potential policy concerns, and opportunities for improvement; and recommend substantive modifications that advance agency objectives and inform executive decision-making. Title: Sr. Operations Manager at Exec Villas
Description:
**The Company**

Pavilion is building the best vacation rental company in the world. We launched May 1, 2026 and today bring together 20 local property management companies across five regions, with more than 5,000 homes under management and about one million guest stays a year. We support the entrepreneurial operators and communities that manage some of the most valuable assets their owners will ever hold.

Our model combines local expertise with the scale and efficiency of a national operation. Local brands keep their identity. Founders stay as equity partners. Our Mission Control team builds the technology, tools, and shared infrastructure that independent operators cannot build alone. A shared AI service layer will improve revenue, marketing, finance, and operations across the full portfolio, all in service of world-class hospitality for our guests.

The executive team includes veterans from ResortQuest, Compass, Bridgewater, Overmoon, Wheelhouse, Inhabit, Grand Welcome, and Lerer Hippeau.

If you want to build a defining brand in travel and hospitality, back the entrepreneurs who make it run, and use AI to power the whole thing, come build with us.

**Role at a Glance**

**Property Management Company:** Executive Villas, A Pavilion Collection Company

**Location:** Orlando, FL area; remote-first, in person with the team about once a month

**Reports to:** General Manager

**Direct report:** Front Desk / Guest Relations lead

**Works side by side with:** Operations Manager (Field Operations) and our Operations Systems lead (Breezeway)

**Type:** Full-time, W-2. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

**Languages:** English, Portuguese and Spanish (all three required)

**About the role**

Executive Villas manages vacation homes in the Orlando area and is part of Pavilion Collection, a growing group of property management companies. Our guests are families and groups on vacation, and a great stay depends on dozens of people and vendors getting the details right in every home.

Today, operations and guest experience are split across several people. This role brings them together under one owner. You will run day-to-day operations across housekeeping, maintenance, pools, game rooms and every vendor that touches a home, and you will own the guest relationship when things go wrong.

The two are tied on purpose. Most bad reviews start with an operational miss, such as a late clean, a broken AC or a pool that wasn't serviced. You will use the data to see those misses coming, fix the root cause with the field team and vendors, and turn around guests who had a bad moment. You are not just answering complaints. You are preventing them. As Exec Villas grows, there is room for this role to grow with it.

**What you’ll own**

**Guest experience and ratings**

* Own guest review scores across every home, and the plan to raise them.
* Take escalations from Front Desk when a guest needs a senior, human touch. Stay calm, read the situation and turn an upset guest into a satisfied one, without defaulting to refunds.
* Follow up with guests after an issue is fixed to confirm they are happy and rebuild the relationship.
* Handle guest escalations by phone, email, and communication through our distribution channels. Field visits to upset guests are not part of this role; you coordinate any in-person delivery through the field team.
* Lead and coach Front Desk / Guest Relations, and set clear rules for what they resolve, what goes to the field team, and what comes to you.
* Ensure that every guest review gets an appropriate response in order to grow Exec Villas’ reputation
* Identify recurring guest complaints and implement corrective actions to prevent similar situations.

**Operations and vendors**

* Run day-to-day operations across housekeeping, maintenance, pools, game rooms and other home services.
* Own all vendor relationships: performance, accountability, renewals and replacing vendors or housekeepers who fall short.
* Work side by side with our Ops Manager, who schedules and directs the field team. You find the problem in the data; he brings the on-the-ground context; together you decide the fix.
* Ensure that Breezeway is updated so tasks are completed on time and the data is reliable.
* Help stand up and guide the new pilot teams (maintenance and supervisor), with the Ops Manager directing them day to day.
* Monitor operational consistency across all managed homes and ensure company standards are maintained.
* Identify recurring service failures and implement process improvements to reduce operational inefficiencies.
* Bring major operational concerns, strategic decisions, and significant financial matters to EV leadership.

**Data and continuous improvement**

* Track guest ratings, review themes, guest complaints, and Breezeway task completion by property, vendor, and housekeeping team.
* Analyze performance data to identify trends, recurring issues, and underperforming homes before they negatively affect guest reviews.
* Establish performance reports and dashboards to monitor operational efficiency and guest satisfaction.
* Identify root causes of recurring problems and implement corrective action plans.
* Monitor vendor performance and identify opportunities to improve service quality and cost efficiency.
* Provide weekly reports to EV leadership outlining performance, challenges, improvements, and actions being taken.
* Use data to support operational decisions rather than relying solely on individual complaints or isolated incidents.
* Work with Operations Systems lead to improve Breezeway reporting, task tracking, and operational visibility.

**How success is measured**

In your first year, guest ratings go up and stay up.

* First 30 days: Get to know every home, vendor and team member. Shadow Front Desk, Ops. Understand baseline ratings and Breezeway completion by home.
* By 90 days: Own all vendor relationships and guest escalations. Escalation rules in place with guest relations. Bottom-rated homes identified, each with a fix plan. Weekly ops
* By 12 months: Average guest rating up versus baseline (where we started). Fewer repeat issues per home. Underperforming vendors replaced. Off-season guest outreach driving repeat and referral bookings.

**Core metrics:** average guest rating at 4.8, Breezeway on-time task completion, repeat issues per home, and escalations resolved without refunds.

**What you bring**

**Required**

* 5+ years in hospitality operations or guest experience, such as hotels, resorts, vacation rentals, with at least 3 years leading people and vendors.
* A track record of raising guest satisfaction or review scores, with numbers to show it.
* Calm under pressure. You can de-escalate an angry guest, understand what they really need and win them back.
* Fluent English, Portuguese and Spanish, spoken and written.
* Comfortable with data. You track metrics, spot trends and act on them.
* Experience managing vendors and holding them to clear standards.
* Authorized to work in the U.S. as a W-2 employee.

**Nice to have**

* Short-term rental experience at a property management company.
* Knowledge of the Orlando vacation rental market
* Hands-on use of Breezeway or similar operations tools, and review or rating platforms.
* Experience building a team or function from scratch at a growing company.

**Who thrives here**

Someone who is proactive, not reactive. You'd rather fix the cause than apologize for the same problem twice. You are as comfortable on a tough guest call as you are in a spreadsheet, and you build trust with field teams you don't directly manage.

Pay: $50,500.00 - $65,100.00 per year

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Language:

* English (Preferred)
* Portuguese (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
